Page 1 · Quick Reference: three numbers to remember first页 1 · 全册速查：先记住 3 个数

The City of Richmond provides these Child Care Design Guidelines to assist City staff and the development community in the creation of child care space within Richmond. Provincial licensing sets the floor; the Guidelines set the City’s expectations for design and finish. Start with the three numbers below, then look the rest up in the cards and the chapter index.这是 City of Richmond 为市属托儿所定的设计指引：省许可定底线，市指引定设计目标。做 Richmond 的托儿所方案，先对齐下面 3 个数，其余查卡片和章节索引。

75 ft²

Outdoor activity area: the City requires 75 ft² (7 sq. m.) per child as a minimum; licensing is set at 65 ft² (6 sq. m.) per child; within the City Centre area, at least 10 sq. m. per child is recommended.室外活动面积：市要求每孩最低 75 ft²（7 m²）；省许可底线是 65 ft²（6 m²）；市中心建议每孩至少 10 m²。[S1]

40 ft²

Main Activity Area, based on a minimum of 40 ft² (3.7 sq. m.) per child.室内主活动区：每孩最低 40 ft²（3.7 m²）。[S2]

Maximum group size组规模上限

Maximum group sizes: Infant 12; Toddler 12; Preschool 20; Multi-Age 8. Fix the program type first, then read any table.婴幼儿各组上限 12 人；学前班 20 人；多年龄组上限 8 人——先定项目类型，再查任何表。[S6]

Guess first, then check先猜再看

Guess first: what share of the play area needs shade?先猜：游乐区要有多少比例的遮阴？

Answer: provide for shade from the hot sun for at least one-third of the play area through trees or shade structures.答案：至少 1/3 的游乐区要有遮阴（树或遮阴构筑物）。[S8]

One more: what ceiling clearance do activity rooms ideally have, at least?再猜：活动室的理想净高至少是多少？

Answer: ceilings with at least 10 ft. of clearance; operable windows not to be opened more than 4 in.答案：活动室与午睡／大运动房理想净高至少 10 ft；可开启窗的开启幅度不超过 4 in。[S9]

Guess first: what is the maximum hot-water temperature at fixtures children can reach?先猜：儿童可及洁具的热水最高是多少？

Answer: water temperature to be at a maximum of 49 degrees C or 120 degrees F, with mixing valves.答案：最高 49 °C（120 °F），须配混水阀。[S7]

Core number cards核心数字卡

Every number carries a citation marker — tap it for the original sentence and its PDF page.每张卡的数字都带角标，点开看英文原句与 PDF 页码。

Outdoor area per child室外每孩面积

The area required for licensing is set at 65 ft² (6 sq. m.) per child; the City requires 75 ft² (7 sq. m.) per child as a minimum; within the City Centre area, at least 10 sq. m. per child is recommended.省许可底线 65 ft²（6 m²）／孩；市要求 75 ft²（7 m²）／孩；市中心建议至少 10 m²／孩。[S1]

Indoor activity baseline室内活动基准

Main Activity Area, based on a min. of 40 ft² or 3.7 sq. m. per child.主活动区最低 40 ft²（3.7 m²）／孩。[S2]

Gross-up factor净面积放大系数

Add in the range of 20% to 30% to the combined net indoor area inclusive of shared and other areas — for walls, circulation, stairways, elevators and service rooms — to get the gross floor area.净室内面积（含共享与其他面积）再加 20% 到 30%，覆盖墙体、交通、楼梯、电梯与设备间，得总建筑面积。[S3]

One set of shared areas共享支持空间 1 套

Total Required Shared Areas 812 ft² (75.4 sq. m.), one set per facility — the Kitchen figure is the minimum size if shared by two programs:全设施只配 1 套，合计 812 ft²（75.4 m²）——厨房数字为 2 项目共用时的最低值：

Two rooms — entry and kitchen — take nearly half the shared total between them (400 of 812).入口与厨房 2 间就占了共享总面积的接近 1/2（400 / 812）。[S4]

Two trigger thresholds2 个触发门槛

Administration Office, required for centres serving 69 children or more; Parent Room, required for centres serving more than 37 children, 75 ft² (7.0 sq. m.).服务 69 名或以上儿童须设行政办公室；超过 37 名儿童须设家长室，家长室面积 75 ft²（7.0 m²）。[S5]

Maximum group sizes组规模上限

Infant 12; Toddler 12; Infant/Toddler combined 12; Preschool 20 (max. 4 hours per day); School Age 24 or 30; Multi-Age 8.Infant 12 人、Toddler 12 人、婴幼儿混合 12 人、学前班 20 人（每日最长 4 小时）、学龄组 24 或 30 人、多年龄组 8 人。[S6]

Hot water safety limit热水安全上限

Water temperature to be at a maximum of 49 degrees C or 120 degrees F at fixtures accessible to children, with mixing valves.儿童可及洁具的热水最高 49 °C（120 °F），须配混水阀。[S7]

Shade遮阴

Provide for shade from the hot sun for at least one-third of the play area.至少 1/3 的游乐区要有遮阴，挡住烈日。[S8]

Ceiling height and window opening层高与开窗

Ceilings with at least 10 ft. of clearance; windows not to be opened more than 4 in.活动室理想净高至少 10 ft；可开启窗开启不超过 4 in。[S9]

All program types — do not miss a single one类别总览 · 不要漏掉任何 1 类

Licensed programs generally operate up to 13 hours per day. The eight types below, with their age ranges and group-size limits, come from the definitions chapter. Types marked “no area table” have no Appendix A space summary table — only a definition and a group-size limit — and this site does not invent areas for them.指引定义的持牌项目一般最长 13 小时／日；下面 8 类的年龄段与人数上限都来自定义章。带「无面积表」标注的类别，附录 A 没有面积汇总表，只有定义与人数上限，本站不替它们编面积。[B1]

Group Child Care (Under 36 Months)Group Care · 36 个月以下[B1]

Birth to 36 months; grouped as Infant, Toddler or Infant/Toddler combined, maximum group size 12. Appendix A area table — see Page 3.出生到 36 个月；按婴儿、幼儿、混合分班，每组上限 12 人。有附录 A 面积表（页 3）。[B1][S6]

Group Child Care (30 Months to School Age)Group Care · 30 个月到学龄[B1]

30 months to school age; maximum group size 25. Appendix A area table — see Page 3.30 个月到学龄；每组上限 25 人。有附录 A 面积表（页 3）。[B1][S6]

PreschoolPreschool 学前班

30 months to school age, up to 4 hours per day; maximum group size 20. Appendix A area table — see Page 3.30 个月到学龄，每日不超过 4 小时；每组上限 20 人。有附录 A 面积表（页 3）。[B1]

Group Child Care (School Age)Group Care · School Age 学龄

Kindergarten to 12 years, before- and after-school care; maximum group size 24 or 30 (conditions in the Page 3 footnotes). Appendix A area table.幼儿园到 12 岁，课前课后托管；每组上限 24 或 30 人（条件见页 3 脚注）。有附录 A 面积表。[B1]

Multi-AgeMulti-Age 多年龄

Infants to 12 years in one mixed-age group; maximum group size 8. No Appendix A area table — definition and group-size limit only.婴儿到 12 岁混合年龄；最大组 8 人。附录 A 无面积表，只有定义与人数上限。[B1]

Family & In-Home Multi-AgeFamily & In-Home Multi-Age 家庭托儿

In the licensee's own home; maximum group size 7 or 8, depending on the caregiver's qualifications. No Appendix A area table — definition and group-size limit only.设在持牌照顾者家中；最大组 7 或 8 人，视照顾者资格而定。附录 A 无面积表，只有定义与人数上限。[B1]

OccasionalOccasional 临时托儿

Occasional, short-term child care. No Appendix A area table — definition and group-size limit only.临时、短期的托儿服务。附录 A 无面积表，只有定义与人数上限。[B1]

Child MindingChild Minding 活动看护

Care provided while parents are on site taking part in activities. No Appendix A area table — definition and group-size limit only; the book states this is not the focus of these Guidelines.家长在场参加活动时提供的看护。附录 A 无面积表，只有定义与人数上限；原书明说这不是本指引的重点。[B1]

Can you answer these?你答得上来吗

Q: For outdoor area, what are the licensing floor and the City requirement, per child?问：室外面积上，省许可底线与市要求分别是每孩多少？

Licensing is set at 65 ft² per child; the City requires 75 ft² (7 sq. m.) per child.省许可底线 65 ft²／孩，市要求 75 ft²（7 m²）／孩。[S1]

Q: To go from net indoor area to gross floor area, how much do you add?问：由净室内面积推总建筑面积，要加多少？

Add in the range of 20% to 30% to the combined net indoor area.在合并净室内面积上加 20% 到 30%。[S3]

Q: Serving how many children or more makes an Administration Office required?问：服务多少名或以上儿童时，行政办公室成为必需？

69 or more requires an Administration Office; more than 37 triggers the Parent Room instead.69 名或以上须设行政办公室；超过 37 名触发的是家长室。[S5]

Q: How large are the Total Required Shared Areas for one facility?问：1 所设施的必备共享支持空间合计多大？

Total Required Shared Areas 812 ft² (75.4 sq. m.), one set per facility.合计 812 ft²（75.4 m²），全设施只配 1 套。[S4]

Page 2 · Interior Spaces in Depth: how one group’s spaces fit together页 2 · 室内深做：1 个班的空间怎么拼

This page takes apart two things: which spaces make up one group (a 3–5 years group as the worked example, then the under-3 groups), and the key requirements room by room. Open the fold-outs to see every area line by line.这一页拆 2 件事：1 个班由哪些空间拼成（以学前大班为样例，再补婴幼儿班），以及每间房的关键做法。所有面积点开折叠层逐项看。

Guess first, then check先猜再看

Guess first: how deep is the sink in the Infant and Toddler Diaper Change Area?先猜：婴幼儿换尿布区的水槽要多深？

Answer: a 12 in. deep single compartment sink, with swing tap and hand spray attachment.答案：12 in 深的单槽水槽，配摇摆龙头与手持喷头。[R2]

One more: what total area do the Nap Rooms get in the under-3 tables?再猜：婴幼儿班的午睡房总面积写的是多少？

Answer: 280 ft² — for infants, 2 nap rooms required at 13 sq. m. each.答案：280 ft²——婴儿班须设 2 间、每间 13 m²。[R7]

Guess first: how large is the Cubby Area in the 3–5 years worked example (25 children)?先猜：样例 3–5 岁班（25 人）的 Cubby 区有多大？

Answer: the Cubby Area is 150 ft² in the 3–5 table; 130 ft² is the under-3 figure.答案：3–5 岁表里 Cubby 区是 150 ft²；130 ft² 是 3 岁以下班的数字。[R5]

Bottle warming area: not dropped when a kitchen is shared温奶区：共用厨房也不能省

A bottle warming area with a sink, counter, microwave and under counter fridge may still need to be provided for programs serving infants and toddlers even if two programs are sharing a kitchen.即使 2 个项目共用厨房，服务婴幼儿的项目仍可能要单独设温奶区，配水槽、台面、微波炉与台下冰箱。[R10]

Quick comparison · key differences, under-3 groups vs. the 3–5 group小对比 · 婴幼儿班与学前大班的关键差异

  • Nap rooms: under-3 groups get separate nap rooms with the area fixed at 280 ft² (infants: two rooms at 13 sq. m. each); the 3–5 group combines nap with gross motor in one room.午睡房：婴幼儿是独立房间、面积写死 280 ft²（婴儿须 2 间、每间 13 m²）；学前大班是与大运动合并的房间。[R7]
  • Washrooms: under-3 groups combine the washroom and diapering area at 80 ft²; the 3–5 Children's Washroom is 118 ft², with no diapering area.洗手间：婴幼儿把洗手间与换尿布区合并计 80 ft²；学前大班儿童洗手间为 118 ft²、没有换尿布区。[R7][R5]
  • Cubby Area: 130 ft² for under-3 groups, 150 ft² for the 3–5 group.储物柜区：婴幼儿 130 ft²，学前大班 150 ft²。[R7][R5]
  • Gross motor: under-3 groups have no combined gross-motor room; the 3–5 Gross Motor-Nap Room is 360 ft².大运动：婴幼儿没有大运动合并房；学前大班的大运动／午睡合并房为 360 ft²。[R5]

Room-by-room requirements逐间房要求

Nap Room (also Gross Motor)午睡房（兼大运动）

For all full-day programs, a nap room that meets CCFL size requirements is required. This room is also used for gross motor and play activities in Group Care (30 months to school age) programs.所有全日制项目都必须设符合许可尺寸要求的午睡房；30 个月到学龄的班型里，这间房同时作大运动与游玩空间。[R1]

Diaper Change Area换尿布区

12 in. deep single compartment sink, with swing tap and hand spray attachment. Change table millwork cabinet with space for steps and provide an opening in the countertop to access a disposal bin.12 in 深单槽水槽，配摇摆龙头与手持喷头；换台柜带放台阶的空间，台面开孔通向下方垃圾桶。[R2]

Art Area sinks美术区水槽

Provide a floor-mounted sediment trap for all art sinks. Provide temperature control for hot water (120 degrees F maximum). Consider providing a second, lower art sink for children.所有美术水槽配落地式沉淀隔；热水温度受控、最高 120 °F；可考虑再设 1 个更低的儿童用水槽。[R3]

Children’s Washroom儿童洗手间

Children’s toilets to be tank style, with round bowls. Number of fixtures and Children’s Washrooms to meet CCFL requirements — the Guidelines give no ratio, so do not invent one.儿童马桶为水箱式、圆座；洁具数量与洗手间配置按许可要求定——指引本身不给配比，别自行编数。[R4]

安静室 Quiet Room

A room with its own section in the appendix: a separate room with a door, where one staff member can take a small group of children away from the noise of the activity area for quiet activities or one-on-one time. The book gives no area figure for it, and this site does not invent one.附录里单独成节的 1 间房：独立成间、带门，供 1 名工作人员带 1 小群孩子离开活动区的喧闹，做安静活动或 1 对 1 陪伴。它没有独立面积数字，本站不替它编数。[B6]

Support space list (qualitative)支持空间清单（定性）

Every program must also provide: storage (active, semi-active, mat and cot, stroller and emergency supplies), children’s washrooms, an accessible washroom and a staff washroom, and administration and other support spaces.每个项目还要配齐：储藏（日常用、半常用、睡垫与小床、婴儿车、应急物资）、儿童洗手间、无障碍洗手间与员工洗手间、行政等支持空间。[R6]

Dimensions by age group (Appendix L)按年龄段的人体尺度

The same fixture sits at a different height for each age group — pick the wrong row and the counter is out of reach. Unit: inches (in.).同一件洁具，不同年龄段高度不同——选错 1 行，台面就够不着或用不了。单位：英寸（in）。

Four items for all areas全场通用 4 项

  • Blind cords: bottom of cord min. 60 in. from the floor.窗帘绳下端距地至少 60 in。[B5]
  • Wall protection: min. 36 in. high.墙面防撞层高度至少 36 in。[B5]

Q: What is the NET INDOOR AREA of the worked-example 3–5 years group?问：样例学前大班的净室内总面积是多少？

2,041 ft² (189.5 sq. m.) = activity 1,369 + support 672.2,041 ft²（189.5 m²）＝活动区 1,369 ＋支持空间 672。[R5]

Q: Why is the Infant total smaller than the Toddler total?问：婴儿班为什么总面积比幼儿班小？

Support is 600 for both; activity totals are 757 (Infant) and 811 (Toddler), so NET INDOOR AREA is 1,357 vs. 1,411.2 班支持空间同为 600；婴儿班活动区合计 757、幼儿班 811，所以净室内为 1,357 对 1,411。[R7][R8]

Q: When two programs share a kitchen, what may an infant/toddler program still need on its own?问：2 个项目共用厨房时，婴幼儿项目还可能要单独设什么？

A bottle warming area: sink, counter, microwave and under counter fridge.温奶区：水槽、台面、微波炉与台下冰箱。[R10]

Q: What is the children's washroom counter height for a School Age program?问：学龄项目的儿童洗手台台面高是多少？

Appendix L sets the School Age washroom counter at 28–30 in.; 18–20 in. is the under-36-months figure.附录 L 里学龄组洗手台高 28–30 in；18–20 in 是 36 个月以下组的数字。[B5]

Q: What gross-up range turns net area into gross floor area?问：净面积放大成总建筑面积，加的比例区间是多少？

20% to 30%, added to the combined net indoor area. Every gross area this page’s calculator gives is calculated under that rule.Calculated20% 到 30%，加在合并净室内面积上。本页计算器给出的总面积都是按这条规则推算的。推算[S3]

Q: What is the Infant NET OUTDOOR AREA?问：婴儿班的净室外总面积是多少？

1,055 ft² = activity areas 969 + Outdoor Storage 86; 969 is the activity total only, without storage.1,055 ft²＝活动区 969 ＋室外储藏 86；969 只是活动区合计，不含储藏。[A2]

Q: How many spaces, and what maximum day, for Preschool?问：学前班的名额与每天最长时长是？

Preschool: 20 spaces, up to 4 hours per day; the 25-space full-day type is 3–5 Care.Preschool 20 人，每日最长 4 小时；25 人全日制的是 3–5 Care。[A1][S6]

Q: What is the Preschool NET OUTDOOR AREA (20 children)?问：学前班（20 人）的净室外面积是多少？

Covered 506 + Open 1,001 = 1,507, plus Storage 86 gives 1,593 ft²; 1,984 ft² is the 3–5 group.有盖 506＋露天 1,001＝1,507，再加储藏 86，净室外 1,593 ft²；1,984 ft² 是 3–5 岁班。[B2]

Page 4 · Technical Standards: the City’s own specifications页 4 · 技术标准速查：市属系统的硬规格

Pages 1–3 cover space and area. This page collects the City of Richmond technical standards from Appendices B–J and §5.3.12–5.3.13: filtration and fixture flow rates, DDC, lighting and exit signs, entrance intercom, fire alarm monitoring, access and video, garbage containers, rooftop soil depths, irrigation, and the toxic plant list. Where the original names a model and says “no substitutions” or “no exceptions allowed”, the model is the requirement — check the citation before substituting anything.前 3 页管空间与面积；这一页收市属技术标准（附录 B–J 与正文 §5.3.12–5.3.13）：过滤与洁具流量、DDC、照明与出口标志、入口对讲、消防监控、门禁与视频、垃圾桶、屋顶覆土、灌溉与有毒植物。原文点名型号并写明「不得替换／不许例外」的地方，型号本身就是要求——替换任何设备前先点角标对原文。

Guess first, then check先猜再看

Guess first: how many 240-litre garbage containers must the garbage storage area accommodate?先猜：垃圾存放区要能放下多少只 240 升垃圾桶？

Answer: the garbage area is sized to accommodate nine 240 litres garbage containers.答案：垃圾存放区按容纳 9 只 240 升垃圾桶 sizing。[T10]

One more: on a rooftop playground, what is the minimum soil depth over slab for trees?再猜：屋顶游乐场板上覆土，种树的最小深度是多少？

Answer: 900 mm minimum for trees — 450 mm is for shrubs and perennials, 300 mm for lawn.答案：种树最小 900 mm——450 mm 是灌木与多年生植物，300 mm 是草坪。[T11]

Guess first: what minimum MERV rating must filtration equipment meet?先猜：过滤设备的最低 MERV 等级是多少？

Answer: utilize a Minimum Efficiency Reporting Value (MERV) of at least 11; where applicable, MERV 13 GeoPleat or Mini-Pleat filters must be used.答案：最低 MERV 11；适用处须用 MERV 13 的 GeoPleat 或 Mini-Pleat。[T1]

Appendix B · Building equipment: filtration and fixture flow rates附录 B · 建筑设备：过滤与洁具流量

Filtration media — MERV过滤介质 — MERV 等级

Utilize Minimum Efficiency Reporting Value (MERV) of at least 11 for equipment that requires filtration material. Where applicable, GeoPleat or Mini-Pleat filter with MERV 13 must be used.需要过滤材料的设备，过滤等级至少 MERV 11；适用场合必须用 MERV 13 的 GeoPleat 或 Mini-Pleat 过滤器。[T1]

§5.3.12–5.3.13 + Appendix C · CO/CO₂ monitoring and DDC正文 §5.3.12–5.3.13＋附录 C · CO/CO₂ 监测与 DDC

Carbon dioxide and monoxide monitoring二氧化碳与一氧化碳监测

Install permanent, hard-wired carbon dioxide and monoxide monitoring systems, in at minimum the activity rooms and the gross motor/nap rooms; each room is controlled independently, and DDC follows Appendix C.至少在活动室与大运动／午睡房装永久、硬接线的二氧化碳与一氧化碳监测系统；各房间可独立控制；DDC 按附录 C。[T3]

Direct Digital Control (DDC)直接数字控制 DDC

For mechanical and lighting controls in City-owned or City-operated spaces, the DDC work must be done by one of the City’s two pre-qualified contractors: ESC Automation or Control Solutions.市有／市营空间的机电与照明 DDC 控制，必须由市府 2 家预审承包商之 1 施工：ESC Automation 或 Control Solutions。[T4]

Appendix D · General lighting guidelines附录 D · 通用照明指引

Light sources and daylight harvesting光源与自然光利用

Indoors, LED and linear fluorescent are preferred; outdoors, LED is preferred; and spaces with daylight shall incorporate daylight harvesting.室内照明优先 LED 与线性荧光；室外优先 LED；有自然光的空间实施 daylight harvesting（日光感应调光）。[T5]

Exit signs出口标志

The “Running Man” style EXIT sign that conforms to CAN/ULC-S572: LED light source, NiCad emergency battery, 120V supplied from the emergency power distribution. Egress lighting follows the BC Building Code and the Canadian Electrical Code.出口标志用「Running Man」式、符合 CAN/ULC-S572：LED 光源、NiCad 应急电池、120V 由应急配电供电；出口照明按 BCBC 与 Canadian Electrical Code。[T6]

Appendix E · Entrance intercom/video systems specifications附录 E · 入口对讲／视频系统规格

Entry audio intercom and electric strike入口语音对讲与电锁扣

All specified entry doors shall be controlled by an entry audio intercom which will communicate via a supplied phone line. Acceptable part numbers are Viking K-1200 or K-1200EWP, no exceptions allowed. The entry door unit is flush mounted at a height of no higher than 44 in. All required entry door locations shall have a 12 volt electric strike installed to release the door — RCI S6514 series.指定入口门由入口语音对讲（电话线）控制；可接受型号只有 Viking K-1200 或 K-1200EWP，不许例外（no exceptions allowed）。门机齐平安装、高度不超过 44 in；入口门装 12V 电锁扣开门——RCI S6514 series。[T7]

Appendix F · Security, fire alarm systems specifications附录 F · 安防与消防报警系统规格

ULC fire alarm monitoring消防报警监控

All fire alarm panels must be monitored for Alarm, Supervisory/Tamper and Trouble. The fire alarm monitoring system panel must be a DSC 4116 ULC Fire Kit, no substitutions. The panel is mounted at a height of no higher than 72 in., out of reach for children. Space at the wiring termination point: 24 in. × 30 in. for the alarm security panel termination point, and 24 in. × 24 in. for the alarm panels.所有消防报警主机须监控 Alarm / Supervisory-Tamper / Trouble 3 种状态；主机须为 DSC 4116 ULC Fire Kit，不得替换（no substitutions）。安装高度不超过 72 in 且儿童够不到；接线端接空间：安防报警端接点 24 in × 30 in、报警主机端接 24 in × 24 in。[T8]

Access systems and video systems门禁与视频系统

All specified entry doors shall be controlled via a HID proximity card reader. The Access system must be a Honeywell Webs-AX system, with a minimum of one H602 controller. All digital video cameras must be a Hikvision or similar; proprietary equipment is not accepted.入口门用 HID 感应读卡器控制；门禁系统须为 Honeywell Webs-AX，至少 1 台 H602 控制器；数字摄像机用 Hikvision 或同类，不得用专有设备。[T9]

Appendices G, H, I · Garbage containers, rooftop playgrounds, irrigation附录 G、H、I · 垃圾桶、屋顶游乐场、灌溉

Garbage container specifications (Appendix G)垃圾桶规格（附录 G）

The garbage storage area is sized to accommodate nine 240 litres garbage containers. One container:垃圾存放区须容纳 9 只 240 litres 垃圾桶。单只尺寸：

Size the storage area for all nine, not for one.存放区按 9 只总量留，不要按 1 只算。[T10]

Rooftop playground: soil over slab (Appendix H)屋顶游乐场：板上覆土（附录 H）

Planters are a minimum of 900mm width and include high efficiency irrigation. Growing medium follows the BC Landscape Standard, Level 2 “Groomed” and Level 3 “Moderate”, and a soil analysis report is submitted before site access. Minimum soil depths over slab:种植池最小宽 900mm 并配高效灌溉；种植土按 BC Landscape Standard Level 2 “Groomed” 与 Level 3 “Moderate”；进场前须交土壤分析报告。板上覆土最小深度：

Same three depths as the outdoor chapter — here they sit on structure.与室外章同 3 档深度——这里是压在结构板上。[T11]

Irrigation design (Appendix I)灌溉设计（附录 I）

Controller to be Toro Sentinel Satellite SSAK-12XXX-6-N-S. Irrigation drawings are submitted to City Parks for review, and Parks Operations inspects the installation.控制器指定 Toro Sentinel Satellite SSAK-12XXX-6-N-S；灌溉施工图须送 City Parks 审查，安装后由 Parks Operations 验查。[T12]

Many plants commonly used in landscaping in North America have toxic properties that can be harmful to children. The use of these plants for soft landscaping in child care outdoor areas must be avoided.北美景观中常用的许多植物带有对儿童有害的毒性；托儿所室外软景不得使用这些植物。[T13]

Can you answer these?你答得上来吗

Q: Where applicable, which filter must be used?问：适用场合必须用哪种过滤器？

Where applicable, GeoPleat or Mini-Pleat filter with MERV 13 must be used; the general floor is MERV 11.适用处须用 MERV 13 的 GeoPleat 或 Mini-Pleat；一般底线是 MERV 11。[T1]

Q: What style and standard must exit signs meet?问：出口标志用什么式样、符合什么标准？

The “Running Man” style EXIT sign that conforms to CAN/ULC-S572, with an LED source and a NiCad emergency battery.「Running Man」式、符合 CAN/ULC-S572，LED 光源配 NiCad 应急电池。[T6]

Q: Which fire alarm monitoring panel is specified — and can it be substituted?问：消防监控主机指定哪 1 款——可以替换吗？

The fire alarm monitoring system panel must be a DSC 4116 ULC Fire Kit, no substitutions, monitored for Alarm, Supervisory/Tamper and Trouble.主机须为 DSC 4116 ULC Fire Kit，不得替换；监控 Alarm / Supervisory-Tamper / Trouble。[T8]

Q: At most how high may the fire alarm panel be installed?问：消防报警主机最高可装到多高？

Panels are installed at a maximum of 72 in. and out of reach of children; 44 in. is the entry intercom limit.主机安装高度不超过 72 in 且儿童够不到；44 in 是入口对讲的上限。[T8]

§1.0 · Introduction§1.0 · 绪论与适用（Introduction）

What this document is, whom it binds, and what a day inside a child care program actually looks like — the three things to settle before reading any number in the later chapters.这份文件是什么、对谁有约束力、托儿所里的 1 天实际怎么过——读后面任何数字之前，先把这 3 件事定下来。

Status, intent and scope文件的地位、意图与适用范围

Approved in 2015, an administrative document2015 年批准，属行政文件

The City of Richmond Child Care Design Guidelines were approved by City Council on September 14, 2015 as an administrative document to be updated from time to time. They assist City staff and the development community in the creation of child care space within Richmond, for child care space in city-owned or city-leased premises.本指引于 2015 年 9 月 14 日经市议会批准，属可不时更新的行政文件；它帮助市府人员与开发界在市有或市租场所内创建托儿空间。[C1]

Intent: clarity on the City’s expectations意图：讲清市府的期望

The intent of the Child Care Design Guidelines is to provide clarity for developers, architects and child care operators regarding the City’s expectations for the design and finish of child care facilities that will become municipal assets.指引的意图，是向开发商、建筑师与运营方讲清市府对「将成为市政资产」的托儿设施在设计与饰面上的期望。[C2]

Where it applies — and where it does not适用范围——管哪些、不管哪些

While the document may be used as a resource by anyone considering building new child care facilities in Richmond, it will only apply to child care facilities built as City capital projects or developer-built community amenity contributions related to rezoning processes.任何人都可以把这份文件当参考，但它正式只适用于 2 类：市资本项目建的托儿设施，以及与 rezoning 相关的开发商社区配套贡献（community amenity contributions）。[C2]

Not minimum standards不是最低标准

The intent is not to provide minimum standards of design, but to establish guidelines that engage the creative talents of designers and developers to help deliver quality facilities. Governing legislation and bylaws — the BC Building Code, the Community Care and Assisted Living Act and the Child Care Licensing Regulation among them — always prevail over the Guidelines.它的意图不是给出最低设计标准，而是立 1 套引导设计者发挥创意、交付高质量设施的指引。上位法例与附例（BCBC、《Community Care and Assisted Living Act》、《Child Care Licensing Regulation》等）永远优先于本指引。[C3]

Why §1.5 shows a typical day first为什么先给「典型的 1 天」

Child care facilities are a relatively complex building type. Central to successful design is an understanding of the activities and routines that organize daily life in the facility, and how these relate to specific age groups. Table 1 therefore gives examples of a typical day in a full-day program: gradual arrival from 7:00 am, caregiving routines and outdoor play through the morning, lunch, a nap or quiet period, afternoon free play and outdoor play, and gradual departure before the centre closes at 6:00 pm. The times are examples — typically flexible, allowing for gradual transitions.托儿设施是相对复杂的建筑类型；设计成功与否，关键在理解组织日常生活的活动与作息、以及它们与年龄段的关系。因此原书 Table 1 先给出全日制项目的「典型 1 天」：早上 7:00 起陆续到达，上午是照护流程与户外活动，午餐后午睡或安静时段，下午自由玩耍与户外活动，傍晚陆续离开，中心 6:00 pm 关闭。时间只是示例，通常可灵活调整、留出从容过渡。[C4]

Guess first, then check先猜再看

Guess first: in which year did City Council approve these Guidelines?先猜：这份指引是哪 1 年经市议会批准的？

Answer: approved by City Council on September 14, 2015.答案：2015 年 9 月 14 日经市议会批准。[C1]

Guess first: licensed child care programs generally operate up to how many hours per day?先猜：持牌托儿项目一般每天最长运营多少小时？

Answer: licensed programs generally operate up to 13 hours per day.答案：持牌项目一般最长 13 小时／日。[B1]

Guess first: more than how many children makes a Parent Room required?先猜：超过多少名儿童就必须设家长室？

Answer: a Parent Room is required for centres serving more than 37 children; 69 is the Administration Office trigger.答案：超过 37 名须设家长室；69 名触发的是行政办公室。[S5]

Can you answer these?你答得上来吗

Q: To which facilities do the Guidelines formally apply?问：这份指引正式适用于哪类设施？

Only City capital projects or developer-built community amenity contributions related to rezoning processes; anyone else may use it as a resource.只适用于市资本项目或与 rezoning 相关的开发商配套贡献；其他人可作参考资源使用。[C2]

Q: How do the Guidelines describe their own role on design standards?问：指引如何描述自己在设计标准上的定位？

“The intent is not to provide minimum standards of design, but to establish guidelines that engage the creative talents of designers and developers.”原文：意图不是提供最低设计标准，而是立 1 套激发设计者与开发商创意的指引。[C3]

Q: To turn net indoor area into gross floor area, how much is added?问：净室内面积换算总建筑面积时加多少？

Add in the range of 20% to 30% to the combined net indoor area.在合并净室内面积上加 20% 到 30%。[S3]

Q: Which program type has no Appendix A area summary table?问：哪类项目没有附录 A 面积汇总表？

Multi-Age, Family, Occasional and Child Minding have definitions and group-size limits only — no Appendix A area table; Preschool has one.Multi-Age、Family、Occasional、Child Minding 只有定义与人数上限，没有附录 A 面积表；学前班有。[B1]

§2.0 · Definitions Pertaining to Child Care§2.0 · 定义与项目类型（Definitions Pertaining to Child Care）

The regulatory language of child care is specific: align the age words, the program types and the group-size limits here first. The full program-type overview is on Page 1; this section page keeps the definitions and the limits.托儿监管有 1 套专门用语：先在这里把年龄词、项目类型与人数上限对齐。类别总表在页 1，本页只放定义要点与人数上限复述。

The age words年龄词的定义

Infant / ToddlerInfant / Toddler

Infant: a child under the age of 18 months. Toddler: a child between 18 and 36 months.Infant（婴儿）：18 个月以下；Toddler（幼儿）：18 到 36 个月。[C5]

Preschooler / School Age ChildPreschooler / School Age Child

Preschooler: a child who is at least 30 months of age but has not yet entered Grade 1. School Age Child: a child who has entered school, typically between 5 and 12 years of age.Preschooler（学前儿童）：至少 30 个月、尚未进入 1 年级；School Age Child（学龄儿童）：已入学，通常 5 到 12 岁。[C5]

Who licenses and monitors谁发牌、谁监管

The Community Care Facilities Licensing (CCFL) Program is responsible for the licensing and monitoring of child and residential licensed facilities. In Richmond, the program is administered by Vancouver Coastal Health.CCFL 负责持牌儿童与住宿设施的发牌与监管；在 Richmond，该项目由 Vancouver Coastal Health 管理。[C55]

Four Standards of Practice4 项实务标准

At the date of printing of this document there are four standards of practice that apply to licensed child care facilities: Active Play, Family Child Care, Safe Play Space, and Water Safety. Standards of Practice created by the Director of Licensing are enforceable as regulations.本书付印时，适用于持牌托儿设施的实务标准共有 4 项：Active Play、Family Child Care、Safe Play Space、Water Safety。由 Director of Licensing 制定的实务标准具有法规效力。[C6]

Program types and maximum group sizes, restated项目类型与最大组规模（复述）

A Child Care Program typically describes licensed child care which takes place outside an individual’s home and may be provided for up to 13 hours per day. The eight types and their limits:Child Care Program 通常指在个人住宅之外提供的持牌托儿，最长可达每天 13 小时。8 类及其上限：[B1]

Type (original name)类型（原书名）Maximum group size最大组规模
Group Child Care (Under 36 Months)12[S6]
Group Child Care (30 Months to School Age)25[S6]
Preschool（每日 ≤4 小时 / up to 4 hours per day）20[B1]
Group Child Care (School Age)24 or 30[S6]
Multi-Aged Child Care8[B1]
Family Child Care and In-Home Multi-Age Care7 or 8[B1]
Occasional Child CareOccasional / short-term basis; no fixed group figure stated in the definition临时／短期；定义里未给固定组数[B1]
Child MindingWhile parents attend on-site activities — not the focus of these Guidelines家长在场参加活动时提供——非本指引重点[B1]

Only the group-care types have Appendix A area tables. Multi-Age, Family, Occasional and Child Minding have definitions and group-size limits only — see Appendix A Part 2 and Page 3 for what the tables do and do not cover.只有团体托儿类有附录 A 面积表；Multi-Age、Family、Occasional、Child Minding 只有定义与人数上限——面积表覆盖范围见附录 A 后半与页 3。

Guess first, then check先猜再看

Guess first: how many Standards of Practice apply to licensed child care facilities?先猜：适用于持牌托儿设施的实务标准有几项？

Answer: four — Active Play, Family Child Care, Safe Play Space, and Water Safety.答案：4 项——Active Play、Family Child Care、Safe Play Space、Water Safety。[C6]

Guess first: what is the maximum group size for Infant care?先猜：Infant 班的最大组规模是多少？

Answer: Infant, Toddler and Infant/Toddler combined groups are capped at 12.答案：Infant、Toddler 与婴幼儿混合组上限都是 12 人。[S6]

Guess first: what is the maximum group size in Family Child Care?先猜：Family Child Care 的最大组规模是多少？

Answer: Family and In-Home Multi-Age Care, in the licensee's own home, is capped at 7 or 8 depending on qualifications.答案：家庭托儿设在持牌者家中，上限 7 或 8 人，视资格而定。[B1]

Can you answer these?你答得上来吗

Q: Which definition fits “Preschooler”?问：哪个是 Preschooler 的定义？

Preschooler: at least 30 months of age but not yet entered Grade 1; 18–36 months is the Toddler definition.Preschooler 是至少 30 个月、未入 1 年级；18 到 36 个月是 Toddler。[C5]

Q: What is the maximum group size for Multi-Aged Child Care?问：Multi-Aged Child Care 的最大组规模是多少？

8 is the maximum group size for Multi-Aged Child Care (infants to 12 year olds in one group).Multi-Aged 最大组 8 人（婴儿到 12 岁同组）。[B1]

Q: What are the Preschool limits on group size and day length?问：学前班的组规模与每日时长上限是？

Preschool: 30 months to school age, maximum group size 20, up to 4 hours per day.学前班：30 个月到学龄，每组上限 20 人，每日最长 4 小时。[S6]

Q: What is Child Minding?问：Child Minding 指的是什么？

Child Minding is care provided while parents are on site taking part in activities; the book notes it is not the focus of these Guidelines.Child Minding 是家长在场参加活动时的看护；原书明说这不是本指引的重点。[B1]

§3.0 · Developing a Child Care Facility: Overview of the Process§3.0 · 开发流程与审批（Developing a Child Care Facility: Overview of the Process）

From rezoning to legal title in ten steps — plus the consultant team, the City’s second hat as future owner, and the one-year landscape maintenance period at the end.从 rezoning 到产权过户的 10 步流程——外加顾问团队、市府「未来业主」的第 2 重身份，以及收尾的 1 年景观维护期。

Table 2: the ten-step processTable 2：10 步流程

A rezoning or development permit may be required for a child care project, and approval of these applications is required before applying for a building permit. The typical process for a new City-owned facility runs:托儿项目可能需要 rezoning 或 development permit，且这些申请获批后才能申请 building permit。新市有设施的典型流程是：[C8]

  1. Rezoning Approval — the application must show site plan, amenity location and size, sun orientation, parking/loading and garbage/recycling locations, and demonstrate sufficient indoor and outdoor space.Rezoning Approval（ rezoning 批准）——申请须展示总平面、配套位置与规模、日照朝向、停车／装卸与垃圾回收位置，并证明室内外空间充足。
  2. Construction Agreement — registered to secure the facility construction; if it is not in place before rezoning adoption, a no-development covenant restricts building permit issuance until it is registered on Title.Construction Agreement（施工协议）——登记以担保设施施工；若 rezoning 通过时协议未就位，先以禁止开发契约限制发 building permit，直至协议登记上 title。
  3. Development Permit — confirms architectural form and character, with design drawings that incorporate zoning, these Guidelines, CCFL regulations and a high level of urban design.Development Permit（开发许可）——确认建筑形式与风貌，设计图须融合 zoning、本指引、CCFL 法规与高水准城市设计。
  4. Building Permit — working drawings and specifications demonstrating compliance with the BC Building Code and Zoning Bylaw. Child care facilities typically are considered “Assembly” type occupancies in the BC Building Code.Building Permit（施工许可）——施工图与规格须证明符合 BCBC 与 Zoning Bylaw。托儿设施在 BCBC 中通常属「Assembly」类占用。[C8]
  5. Final Inspection Card (Occupancy) — City final inspection approval that the constructed facility is ready for occupancy.Final Inspection Card (Occupancy)（最终验收卡）——市府最终验收，确认建成设施可入驻。
  6. Richmond Fire Rescue (RFR) — fire rescue’s final inspection approval of the constructed facility.Richmond Fire Rescue (RFR)（消防）——消防部门对建成设施的最终验收批准。
  7. Child Care Facility Application — the operator submits the application to Building Approvals with CCFL-stamped plans; the City confirms the licensed capacity and staff numbers match the approved occupancy load — before a provincial licence is issued.Child Care Facility Application（托儿设施申请）——运营方带 CCFL 盖章图纸向 Building Approvals 提交；市府核对持牌容量与员工数与已批占用荷载一致——在这之后省牌照才会发出。
  8. Licensing Approval — once the Final Inspection Card is issued, CCFL inspects the completed facility so a final licence can be issued to the Licensee/Operator.Licensing Approval（牌照批准）——最终验收卡发出后，CCFL 验收建成设施，向持牌人／运营方发最终牌照。
  9. Substantial Completion letter — issued by the City as Future Owner once the facility is constructed and finished in accordance with the IFC plans, the Terms of Reference and these Guidelines.Substantial Completion letter（基本完工函）——设施按 IFC 图纸、Terms of Reference 与本指引建成完工后，由「市府作为未来业主」发出。
  10. Legal Title to the Facility — a legal title is created and ownership is transferred to the City.Legal Title to the Facility（产权过户）——设立法定产权，业主权转移至市府。

Step names and order follow Table 2, “Typical Process for the Development of a New City-owned Child Care Facility”.步骤名称与顺序依原书 Table 2《Typical Process for the Development of a New City-owned Child Care Facility》。[C7]

The team, and the City’s second review顾问团队与市府的第 2 重审查

Required consultants必需顾问

Architect; Landscape Architect; Code Consultant; Mechanical Consultant; Electrical Consultant; Structural Consultant; Civil Consultant; Interior Design Concept Expertise (in-house or external contract); Cost Consultant; and a Commercial Kitchen Consultant if there is a commercial kitchen in the facility.建筑师、景观建筑师、规范顾问、机电（机械／电气）顾问、结构顾问、土木顾问、室内设计概念专长（内部或外聘）、造价顾问；设施内有商业厨房时，再加商业厨房顾问。[C9]

City review as future owner市府作为未来业主的审查

Separate from its approving role, the City reviews construction as future owner at set milestones — framing complete; mechanical, electrical and data rough-in complete; before T-bar ceiling installation; after millwork installation; after painting; deficiency review; final walk-through; owner demonstration/orientation, among others. The City is to be provided with two weeks’ notice prior to each inspection.市府除审批角色外，还以「未来业主」身份在固定节点查验施工——框架完成、机电与数据预埋完成、T-bar 天花安装前、木作安装后、油漆完成后、缺陷复查、最终走查、业主演示／培训等。每次巡查须提前 2 周通知市府。[C10]

Provincial licensing省级牌照

The child care operator is responsible for applying for a licence for City-owned child care facilities; the City selects an operator through a request for proposals process. A Community Care Facility License is approved by Vancouver Coastal Health – CCFL.市有托儿设施的牌照由运营方负责申请；市府通过 RFP 流程选定运营方。Community Care Facility License 由 Vancouver Coastal Health – CCFL 批准。[C55]

One-year landscape maintenance period1 年景观维护期

A one year maintenance period is established for landscaped areas outside of the child care fence and on City property, beginning on the date substantial completion was awarded. A final field review of the landscaped areas is scheduled within the growing season (April 1 to September 15), at least one month prior to the end of the maintenance period.托儿围栏之外、市有土地上的景观区设 1 年维护期，自基本完工授予之日起算。景观区最终实地复查须排在生长季内（4 月 1 日至 9 月 15 日）、且在维护期结束前至少 1 个月进行。[C11]

Guess first, then check先猜再看

Guess first: how many steps are in Table 2’s typical process?先猜：Table 2 的典型流程共有几步？

Answer: ten steps, from Rezoning Approval to Legal Title to the Facility.答案：10 步，从 Rezoning Approval 到 Legal Title to the Facility。[C7]

Guess first: serving how many children or more makes an Administration Office required?先猜：服务多少名或以上儿童须设行政办公室？

Answer: an Administration Office is required for centres serving 69 children or more.答案：服务 69 名或以上儿童须设行政办公室。[S5]

Guess first: how large are the Total Required Shared Areas in Table A-1?先猜：表 A-1 的必备共享空间合计多大？

Answer: Total Required Shared Areas 812 ft² (75.4 m²), one set per facility.答案：必备共享空间合计 812 ft²（75.4 m²），全设施 1 套。[S4]

Can you answer these?你答得上来吗

Q: In the BC Building Code, child care facilities are typically considered which occupancy type?问：在 BCBC 中，托儿设施通常算哪 1 类占用？

“Child care facilities typically are considered ‘Assembly’ type occupancies in the BC Building Code.”原文：托儿设施在 BCBC 中通常属「Assembly」类占用。[C8]

Q: How much notice must the City get before each construction-milestone inspection?问：每个施工节点巡查前，要提前多久通知市府？

“The City is to be provided with two weeks’ notice prior to each inspection.”原文：每次巡查前须给市府 2 周通知。[C10]

Q: What does the 20–30% gross-up cover?问：20–30% 的放大系数覆盖什么？

The gross-up covers walls, circulation, stairways, elevators and service rooms, on top of the combined net indoor area.放大系数覆盖墙体、交通、楼梯、电梯与设备间，加在合并净室内面积之上。[S3]

Q: On what basis is the Main Activity Area sized?问：主活动区按什么基准定面积？

Main Activity Area, based on a min. of 40 ft² or 3.7 m² per child; 65 ft² is the outdoor licensing floor.主活动区每孩最低 40 ft²（3.7 m²）；65 ft² 是室外许可底线。[S2]

§4.1 · Context and Environmental Concerns§4.1 · 场地与出入（Context and Environmental Concerns）

Where the facility sits, how people arrive, and how the boundary keeps children in and strangers out — settled before any room is drawn.设施选在哪里、人怎么到达、边界怎么把孩子留在里面、把陌生人挡在外面——这些在画任何房间之前先定。

Location, grade and light选址、标高与采光

Location in the community社区中的位置

A child care facility should be strategically located to serve local needs, centrally located and close to other community facilities such as community centres, schools, libraries and parks. Facilities should not be located close to major traffic routes, such as highways, or near industrial uses, and are restricted in high aircraft noise areas as outlined in the Official Community Plan. Mixed-use and commercial locations can work, provided traffic, noise, emissions and fumes are mitigated by design.托儿设施应战略性选址服务本地需求：位置居中、靠近社区中心、学校、图书馆与公园等社区设施。不应靠近高速公路等主要交通干道或工业用途，高飞机噪声区按 OCP 受限。混合用途与商业区也可，但须以设计消解交通、噪声、排放与烟气。

Relationship to grade与地面的关系

Child care facilities should be designed to provide barrier-free, same level access from the exterior to the interior. If a child care facility is proposed for an above grade building level, or on upper floors of a building, an elevator is required — of sufficient size and capacity to handle triple strollers, and to transport landscape materials for outdoor play areas.设施应提供室外到室内的无障碍同层到达。若设在地面层以上或建筑上层，必须设电梯——尺寸与载重须能容纳 3 联婴儿车，并能运送室外游乐区的景观材料。[C15]

Indoor and outdoor at the same grade室内外同标高

Ideally, outdoor spaces are provided at the same grade as the indoor space and contiguous with it, and the two should be planned together. If minor changes in grade cannot be avoided, ramps could be installed to ensure accessibility of all indoor and outdoor spaces.理想情况：室外空间与室内同标高、相邻接，两者一并规划。小高差无法避免时，用坡道保证所有室内外空间无障碍可达。

Natural light: window area自然光：窗面积

Window areas should be generous, with measures to avoid solar heat gain and glare — and an even higher percentage could be considered to promote day-lighting. The preferred share in activity spaces:窗面积宜大方，同时避免太阳能增益与眩光——甚至可更高以促进日光照明。活动空间的优选比例：

A window area of at least 20 per cent minimum of the wall area is preferred in child care activity spaces.托儿活动空间的窗面积最好至少为墙面面积的 20%。[C12]

Access, parking and security layers到达、停车与安全层次

Walking, biking, transit first步行、骑行、公交优先

In higher-density areas the preferred means of access is as a pedestrian; Richmond’s flat topography is highly amenable to walking and biking. A barrier-free, accessible, pedestrian-oriented access is important, with covered and secured storage for bicycles, trailers and strollers — a family stroller storage area in a convenient location, preferably close to the facility’s entrance.在高密度区，首选到达方式是步行；Richmond 地势平坦，极适合步行与骑行。无障碍、行人导向的到达很重要，并须为自行车、拖车与婴儿车提供有盖、安全的存放——家庭婴儿车存放区位置便利，最好靠近设施入口。

Parking stalls: generous, signed, never shared停车位：宽松、标牌、不得共用

Locate child care parking spaces close to the front door in a surface lot, or close to the elevator in a parkade. Stalls are to be signed, with times noted — ideally reserved and dedicated for the child care facility’s use 24 hours per day, seven days per week. Shared parking for a child care facility with commercial or residential units is not permitted. Stall width:托儿停车位在地面停车场要靠近正门，在停车库要靠近电梯。车位须设标牌并注明时段——理想是 24 小时、每周 7 天专为托儿设施保留专用。托儿设施不得与商业或住宅单元共用停车。车位宽度：

Size parking and drop-off spaces generously and practically for parents with small children.停车与落客空间要为带幼儿的家长留得宽松、实用。[C13]

Visibility and CPTED可见性与 CPTED

Typically the facility is located so that it is highly visible from the street, with a well-lit entry to reduce the possibility of vandalism — while the boundaries are carefully designed for controlled access and exit. Designers can benefit from knowledge of “CPTED” principles, Crime Prevention Through Environmental Design.通常设施选址要从街道高度可见、入口照明良好以减少 vandalism——同时边界精心设计以受控进出。设计者可借鉴 CPTED（通过环境设计预防犯罪）原则。

Fences, gates and controlled access围栏、门与受控出入

For rooftop or above-grade play space, fences should be set back from the roof parapet line; all rooftop fences and glazed screens must be non-climbable and a minimum of eight feet high. Gates get child-proof latches placed out of children’s reach — but latches must not compromise safe egress and fire exiting under the BC Building Code; gates serving as fire exits may need non-locking panic hardware, possibly a 15 second delayed panic hardware with a localized alarm, hard-wired to the fire alarm system. Controlled access to the facility and program areas is required: a locked front door, ideally glazed so staff can see who is at the door, with an electronic door release; doors into each program space secured with card or keypad controlled access.屋顶或高空游乐区的围栏应从女儿墙线后退；所有屋顶围栏与玻璃屏必须不可攀爬、至少 8 英尺高。围栏门配儿童打不开的门闩、装在孩子够不到的 1 侧——但门闩不得妨碍 BCBC 要求的安全疏散与消防出口；作消防出口的门可能需要非锁定恐慌五金，可用带本地报警、硬接线至消防报警系统的 15 秒延时恐慌五金。设施与各项目区须受控出入：正门上锁、最好带玻璃让员工先看清来人，并配电子开门；进入每个项目空间的门用刷卡或密码受控。[C14]

Guess first, then check先猜再看

Guess first: what minimum share of the wall area should windows take up in activity spaces?先猜：活动空间的窗面积最好至少占墙面面积的多少？

Answer: a window area of at least 20 per cent minimum of the wall area is preferred in child care activity spaces.答案：活动空间窗面积最好至少为墙面面积的 20%。[C12]

Guess first: within the City Centre area, how much outdoor area per child is recommended?先猜：市中心区域建议每孩室外面积是多少？

Answer: at least 10 sq. m. per child is recommended within the City Centre area; 7 m² is the city-wide minimum.答案：市中心建议每孩至少 10 m²；7 m² 是全市最低要求。[S1]

Guess first: how large is the Covered Area in the Infant outdoor table?先猜：Infant 室外表里的有盖区有多大？

Answer: Infant outdoor: Covered Area 323, Open Area 646, total activity areas 969 ft².答案：Infant 室外：有盖 323、露天 646，活动区合计 969 ft²。[A2]

Can you answer these?你答得上来吗

Q: How high must rooftop fences and glazed screens be, at minimum?问：屋顶围栏与玻璃屏最低要多高？

All rooftop fences and glazed screens must be non-climbable and a minimum of eight feet high.所有屋顶围栏与玻璃屏必须不可攀爬、最低 8 英尺高。[C14]

Q: Can a child care facility share its parking with the residential units in the same building?问：托儿设施可以和同楼的住宅单元共用停车吗？

“Shared parking for a child care facility with commercial or residential units is not permitted.” Stalls should be 10 ft wide and signed.原文：托儿设施不得与商业或住宅单元共用停车。车位宽以 10 ft 为佳并须标牌。[C13]

Q: How much of the play area needs shade from the hot sun?问：游乐区要有多少比例遮阴挡烈日？

Provide for shade from the hot sun for at least one-third of the play area, through trees or shade structures.至少 1/3 的游乐区要有遮阴（树或遮阴构筑物）。[S8]

Q: How much Outdoor Storage does the 3–5 years outdoor table allow?问：3–5 岁室外表里的室外储藏是多少？

The 3–5 table allows 100 ft² of Outdoor Storage; 86 ft² is the figure in the Infant, Preschool and School Age tables.3–5 岁表室外储藏 100 ft²；86 ft² 是 Infant、学前班与学龄表的数字。[A3]

§4.2 · Facility Design – Interior Spaces for Child Care§4.2 · 室内空间（Facility Design – Interior Spaces for Child Care）

The space list for one group, the general interior rules (circulation, columns, windows, ceilings, acoustics), the optimum group sizes, and how shared facilities stack programs — with the book’s own relationship diagram, Figure 1. Page 2 works this section’s areas in depth.1 个班的空间清单、室内通用规则（流线、柱子、开窗、天花、声学）、最优组规模，以及共享设施怎么拼项目——附原书自己的关系图 Figure 1。本节的面积在页 2 深做。

Table 3: the spaces of one groupTable 3：1 个班的空间构成

Entry and Cubby Area入口与储物柜区

The Entry: the front door is the face of a child care facility and benefits from a design that provides a warm and welcoming sense of arrival. The Cubby Area: located near the entry and/or access to the outdoor play area; provides storage space for children’s bags as well as room for changing into outdoor play gear.入口：正门是托儿设施的脸面，设计要给出温暖的到达感。储物柜区：靠近入口和／或通往室外游乐区的出口；存孩子的包，并留出换户外装备的空间。

Activity Room, Gross Motor and Nap Room, Quiet Room活动室、大运动与午睡房、安静室

The Activity Room is typically in close proximity to the entry and adjacent the cubbies — the largest of the program spaces, with the other spaces typically arranged contiguous to it. The Gross Motor and Nap Room should be designed so it can open up to the activity room to promote shared use, and located away from noisy areas. The Quiet Room is a separate room or area with a door, for quiet activities involving one staff and a small group of children.活动室通常靠近入口、紧邻储物柜区——是项目空间中最大的 1 间，其余空间一般围绕它布置。大运动与午睡房应设计成可向活动室打开、促进 2 空间共用，并避开嘈杂区域。安静室是独立成间或带门的区域，供 1 名员工带 1 小群孩子做安静活动。[R1]

Kitchen and support spaces厨房与支持空间

The Kitchen, open to the activity room, is used for preparation and clean-up of snacks and lunches. Support spaces complete each program: storage (active, semi-active, storage rooms, sleeping mat/cot, stroller, emergency equipment), children’s washrooms, accessible washroom and staff washroom, administrative office, staff break room, parents room, laundry, janitor’s room, garbage and recycling room, and service rooms (mechanical, electrical and IT/data).厨房向活动室开放，用于准备与清理点心和午餐。支持空间补齐每个项目：储藏（日常、半日常、储藏室、睡垫／小床、婴儿车、应急设备）、儿童洗手间、无障碍与员工洗手间、行政办公室、员工休息室、家长室、洗衣房、清洁间、垃圾回收间与设备间（机械、电气、IT／数据）。[R6]

Circulation and columns流线与柱子

Generally, avoid corridors and provide “open plan” types of space planning; ideally, support spaces open directly into activity areas. Avoid columns that impede activity, flow of movement or supervision and sight lines for educators/staff — and avoid columns at exterior walls that could create entrapment areas for children.一般避免走廊、采用「开放平面」式布局；理想是支持空间直接开向活动区。避免柱子妨碍活动、动线或员工的看护视线——外墙边的柱子还可能形成困住孩子的死角，更要避免。

General interior rules and optimum sizes室内通用规则与最优组规模

Windows, ceilings, acoustics开窗、天花与声学

Windows must be openable for fresh air, with restrictors so they cannot be opened more than 4 in., and screens on all operable windows. Ideally the activity room and the gross motor and nap room have ceilings with at least 10 ft. of clearance; where ceiling heights exceed 10 ft., sound dampening measures may be required. The two noise limits:窗须可开启换气，配限位器使开启不超过 4 in，所有可开启窗配纱窗。活动室与大运动／午睡房理想净高至少 10 ft；净高超过 10 ft 时可能需要吸声措施。2 条噪声限值：

Interior noise in spaces occupied by children, and exterior noise at the site, stay under these levels.儿童占用空间的室内噪声与场地室外噪声都不超过图中水平。[S9][C16]

Optimum group sizes最优组规模

The number of child care spaces in each group is in accordance with Child Care Licensing regulations, and is also the optimal group size in terms of economic viability: Infant 12; Toddler 12; Infant/Toddler combined 12; 3–5 Group 25; Preschool 20; School Age 24 or 30 (24 if Kindergarten and Grade 1 children are enrolled, 30 for Grade 2 to Grade 7); Multiage 8.每组名额既符合许可法规，也是经济上最可行的最优组规模：婴儿 12、幼儿 12、混合 12、3–5 组 25、学前班 20、学龄 24 或 30（含幼儿园与 1 年级时 24，2 到 7 年级时 30）、多年龄 8。[S6]

Shared facilities: 37 / 61 / 69 / 81 spaces共享设施：37 / 61 / 69 / 81 名额组合

Common program types for shared facilities — the same group sizes combine into four standard totals. Sharing lets support spaces combine, so facilities can be delivered with less total building area and less cost:共享设施的常见组合——同一组人数拼成 4 种标准总数。共享使支持空间合并，总建筑面积与造价都更省：

Group sizes stay constant; what changes is which groups share one facility.每组人数不变；变的只是哪些组共用 1 处设施。[C17]

Early Childhood Development Hub幼儿发展中心 ECD Hub

Conceptually, the ECD Hub is a facility including at least two types of licensed child care groups, with additional program areas for enhanced community use — office space and meeting rooms, community gathering space, a reception area, a resource lending library and a commercial kitchen. The additional area cannot be used to add to the size of the licensed components unless it meets licensed-program standards. Its multi-purpose room:ECD Hub 的概念是：包含至少 2 类持牌托儿组的设施，再加供社区使用的附加项目区——办公室与会议室、社区聚集空间、接待区、资源借阅图书馆与商业厨房。附加面积不得计入持牌部分规模，除非它本身达到持牌项目标准。其多功能室面积：

The multi-purpose room is the Hub’s flexible community space.多功能室是中心灵活的社区空间。[C18]

Areas for every group in this section are worked through on 本节每个班的面积在Page 2 · Interior Spaces in Depth页 2 · 室内深做.里逐项深做。

Guess first, then check先猜再看

Guess first: what interior noise level should spaces occupied by children not exceed?先猜：儿童占用空间的室内噪声不宜超过多少？

Answer: interior noise levels should not exceed 45 dB(A); exterior noise levels 55 dB(A).答案：室内不宜超过 45 dB(A)；室外不宜超过 55 dB(A)。[C16]

Guess first: which room must every full-day program have?先猜：全日制项目必须设哪间房？

Answer: for all full-day programs, a nap room that meets CCFL size requirements is required, and it doubles as the gross motor room.答案：全日制项目必须设符合 CCFL 尺寸的午睡房，并兼作大运动房。[R1]

Guess first: how far may operable windows be opened?先猜：可开启窗最多能开多大？

Answer: windows are not to be opened more than 4 in.答案：可开启窗开启不超过 4 in。[S9]

Can you answer these?你答得上来吗

Q: What size of multi-purpose room could an ECD Hub include?问：ECD Hub 可包含多大的多功能室？

A 1,000 to 2,500 ft² multi-purpose room is on the ECD Hub’s list of possible additional program areas.1,000 到 2,500 ft² 的多功能室在 ECD Hub 附加项目区的清单上。[C18]

Q: What makes up a 37 Space shared facility?问：37 名额共享设施由什么拼成？

37 Space Facility: 12 spaces of Group Child Care (Under 36 Months) for a combination of Infants and Toddlers, plus 25 spaces of Group Child Care (30 Months to School Age).37 名额设施：12 名 36 个月以下（婴幼儿组合）＋25 名 30 个月到学龄。[C17]

Q: In the 3–5 worked example, what is the activity-areas subtotal?问：样例 3–5 岁班的活动区小计是多少？

Table Area 360 + Open Play 549 + Quiet 100 + Gross Motor-Nap 360 = 1,369 ft²; 672 ft² is the support-spaces subtotal.桌面区 360＋开放游玩 549＋安静区 100＋大运动／午睡 360＝1,369 ft²；672 ft² 是支持空间小计。[R5]

Q: Which of these is a program support space in the book's list?问：下列哪项在原书的支持空间清单里？

The support list includes several kinds of storage, children's and accessible washrooms, and administration space.支持空间清单包括多类储藏、儿童与无障碍洗手间、行政空间等。[R6]

§4.3 · Facility Design – Outdoor Activity Areas§4.3 · 室外活动区（Facility Design – Outdoor Activity Areas）

Sun, shade, zones and safety dimensions for outdoor play — with the book’s own relationship diagram, Figure 2. This section opens with a one-page outdoor summary (every key number, plus the net outdoor total for all seven program types), and it also carries the book’s Table 4 in full: the 13 suitable trees for rooftop play areas.室外游乐的日照、遮阴、分区与安全尺寸——附原书自己的关系图 Figure 2。本节先给 1 页室外空间总结（全部关键数字＋7 种班型的净室外总面积），并完整收录原书表 4：13 种适合屋顶游乐区的树木。

Outdoor space summary — everything on one screen室外空间总结 · 一页看完

Outdoor play is a licensed, sized and zoned program space, not leftover yard. The whole chapter condenses into the table below; the sections after it expand each row, and Page 3 works the same numbers type by type.室外游乐区是按许可定尺寸、按玩法分区的正式项目空间，不是剩余空地。本节全部要点浓缩在下表里；后面的小节逐项展开，页 3 则按班型逐类算同样的数字。

Item项目Requirement要求
Playable area per child每孩可玩面积Licensing floor 65 ft² (6 m²); City minimum 75 ft² (7 m²); City Centre recommendation at least 10 m². “Playable area” excludes planters and the like.省许可底线 65 ft²（6 m²）；市最低要求 75 ft²（7 m²）；市中心建议至少 10 m²。「可玩面积」不含种植池等非游乐项。[S1]
Covered / open split有盖与露天构成Roughly 1/3 covered + 2/3 open in every Appendix A outdoor table; outdoor storage is added on top of the activity total (per-type totals in the next table).附录 A 每张室外表都约为 1/3 有盖＋2/3 露天；室外储藏另加在活动区合计之上（各班型总数见下表）。[A2]
Sun日照At least 3 hours of sunlight per day at the winter solstice, 2 of them within 9:30–11:30 am or 1:30–4:00 pm.冬至日至少 3 小时日照，其中 2 小时落在上午 9:30–11:30 或下午 1:30–4:00 内。[C19]
Shade遮阴At least 1/3 of the play area shaded, through trees or shade structures.至少 1/3 游乐区有遮阴，靠树或遮阴构筑物。[S8]
Zones分区4 distinct open-air zones — Physical/Active, Dramatic, Nature Play and Social — plus a required covered play area next to the cubby-area entry door.露天区分为 4 区——体能活动、戏剧、自然玩、社交——外加 1 处必备的有盖游乐区，紧邻储物柜区入口门。
Sandbox沙坑1 in every play area, covered and secured when not in use, away from interior entrances. Sand depth at least 12 in. (infant/toddler) or 18 in. (3–5 and preschool).每个游乐区 1 个，不用时加盖并固定，远离室内入口。沙深至少 12 in（婴幼儿）或 18 in（3–5 与学前班）。[C20]
Climbing heights攀爬高度上限Toddlers 3 ft; preschoolers 5 ft; school-age 7.5 ft.幼儿 3 ft；学前儿童 5 ft；学龄儿童 7.5 ft。[C21]
Surfaces and drainage铺面与排水At least 3 different surfaces; engineered wood fibre installed 16 in. deep; paved drainage slopes 2% to 5%; boulders no higher than 18 in.至少 3 种不同铺面；工程木屑安装深度 16 in；铺装排水坡度 2% 到 5%；巨石不高于 18 in。[C22]
Fences围栏Non-climbable; at least 6 ft at grade and 8 ft on rooftops/slab (from the last foothold); openings no more than 4 in. wide.不可攀爬；地面至少 6 ft、屋顶／板上至少 8 ft（自最后落脚点起）；开口宽度不超过 4 in。[C23]
Planting种植Soil depth at least 900 mm (trees), 450 mm (shrubs and perennials), 300 mm (groundcovers and grasses); automatic irrigation in all plant beds; toxic plants prohibited (Appendix J). For what to plant on a rooftop, see Table 4 below.覆土深度至少 900 mm（乔木）、450 mm（灌木与多年生）、300 mm（地被与草）；所有种植床配自动灌溉；有毒植物禁用（附录 J）。屋顶适合种什么，见下面表 4。[C26][T13]
Noise噪声Exterior noise at child-occupied spaces not above 55 dB(A); keep play areas away from traffic noise and exhaust, and mechanical vents out of them.儿童占用空间的室外噪声不超过 55 dB(A)；游乐区远离交通噪声与尾气，机械排风口不得设在区内。[C16]

Net outdoor area by program type (Appendix A, ft²)各班型净室外面积总表（附录 A，ft²）

Program type班型Covered有盖Open露天Storage储藏Net outdoor (activity total)净室外（活动合计）

Infant/Toddler combined (12)婴幼儿混合班（12 人）323646861,055 (969)[A6]

How to read it: activity total = covered + open; net outdoor = activity total + storage. The 3 under-36-months types share identical outdoor figures. Indoor make-up for each type is on Page 3.读法：活动合计＝有盖＋露天；净室外＝活动合计＋储藏。36 个月以下的 3 种班型室外数字完全相同。各班型的室内构成在页 3。 Go to Page 3 · Areas in Depth →去看页 3 · 面积深做 →

Environment: wind, sun, noise环境：风、日照、噪声

Sun exposure at the winter solstice冬至日照

North-facing siting may be a problem unless full sun access can be assured during these times. The requirement, on a winter-solstice day:朝北选址若不能在这些时段保证全日照，会有问题。冬至日的要求：

Outdoor play areas benefit from exposure to sunlight for at least three hours per day at the winter solstice.室外游乐区在冬至日获得至少 3 小时日照。[C19]

Shade and wind遮阴与防风

Provide for shade from the hot sun for at least one-third of the play area through trees or shade structures. Exposure to wind limits the use of outdoor play areas, especially on decks or rooftop locations — locate building mass to shelter play areas from prevailing winds, and use screens, solid fences and extended building walls as windbreaks.至少 1/3 的游乐区要有遮阴（树或遮阴构筑物）。风暴露会限制室外游乐区的使用，露台与屋顶位置尤甚——用建筑体量遮挡主导风，并以屏风、实心围栏与延伸的外墙作防风。[S8]

Traffic, mechanical equipment, glare交通、设备与眩光

Outdoor play areas should not be located where they are negatively impacted by traffic noise or exhaust. Do not locate the building’s mechanical exhaust vents in the outdoor play areas, and keep mechanical or electrical equipment — including mists from cooling towers — from impacting them. Do not specify shiny materials, glossy finishes or bright reflective colours.室外游乐区不应选在受交通噪声或尾气负面影响的位置。建筑机械排风口不得设在游乐区内，机械与电气设备（含冷却塔水雾）不得影响游乐区。不得指定闪亮材料、光泽饰面或高反射亮色。

Covered play area有盖游乐区

A covered play area is required, to provide sheltered play on inclement days and shade on hot days; porches and decks are encouraged. It should be located adjacent to the cubby area entry door, be multipurpose (play, small group activities, outdoor meals, active play on rainy days), include secure outdoor storage, an adult-height shelf for sunscreen and first aid supplies, and exterior childproof electrical outlets on the building fence.必须设有盖游乐区，供坏天气遮蔽游乐与炎热日遮阴；鼓励门廊与露台。它应紧邻储物柜区入口门、多功能（游乐、小组活动、户外用餐、雨天体能活动），并含安全室外储藏、成人高度的置物架（放防晒霜与急救用品），以及围墙上的儿童安全室外插座。

Zones and the safety dimensions分区与安全尺寸

Play zones游乐分区

Uncovered areas are designed as distinct zones: a Physical, Active Play Area (climbing, jumping, sliding, swaying, balancing; a “Trike Path” must be separate from main circulation and not impact quiet zones); a Dramatic Zone (play house, a platform as stage or informal seating; sand or water play); Nature Play (raised garden beds, sensory plants, soil, logs, rounded boulders, water and wind elements); and a Social Zone — a quiet place to sit or talk, with shade in summer and sun exposure in winter.露天区按不同玩法分区：体能活动区（攀爬、跳跃、滑、荡、平衡；「三轮车道」须与主动线分开、不影响安静区）；戏剧区（游戏屋、可作舞台或 informal 座位的平台；沙玩或水玩）；自然玩区（抬高种植床、感官植物、泥土、原木、圆润巨石、水与风元素）；社交区——安静坐谈之处，夏有阴、冬有阳。

Sand depth沙坑深度

A sandbox needs to be included in each play area, covered and secured when not in use, and located away from entrances to interior spaces to prevent sand being tracked inside. Minimum sand depth by group:每个游乐区都要有沙坑，不用时加盖并固定，且远离室内入口以免沙被带进室内。各组的最低沙深：

Deeper sand where the older children dig.年龄越大的孩子，沙越深。[C20]

Climbing equipment heights攀爬设备高度标准

Taller equipment goes at the edge of play areas, with resilient surfacing below as required; protective surfacing under stationary equipment must adhere to the current CSA Playground Standard. Height Standards for Climbing Equipment:较高的设备放在游乐区边缘，下方按要求铺弹性铺面；固定设备下的防护铺面须符合现行 CSA 游乐场标准。攀爬设备高度标准：

The allowed climbing height steps up with the children’s age.允许的攀爬高度随孩子年龄逐级放高。[C21]

Surfaces and drainage铺面与排水

Provide a minimum of 3 different surfaces. An engineered wood chip system such as “Fibar System 300” is to be at least 1 ft. deep — install 16 in. deep, as this material compresses over time. Where pea gravel or play sand is used, all paved surfaces are positively drained at slopes of 2% minimum and 5% maximum, directed towards surface drains. All exposed edges to be rounded and smooth; boulders no higher than 18 in. in play areas.至少提供 3 种不同铺面。工程木屑系统（如「Fibar System 300」）至少 1 ft 深——安装时铺 16 in 深，因材料会随时间压实。用豌豆砾石或游乐沙时，所有铺装面正坡排水，坡度 2% 到 5%，导向地面排水口。所有外露边缘圆润光滑；游乐区内巨石不高于 18 in。[C22]

Planting depths and toxic plants种植深度与有毒植物

Automatic irrigation is provided in all plant beds. Toxic plant material must not be used — see Appendix J for the list of plants to avoid (the full list is on Page 4). Growing medium depths:所有种植床配自动灌溉。不得使用有毒植物材料——避免清单见附录 J（完整清单在页 4）。种植土深度：

All three are minimums, measured as soil depth over the structure.3 者都是最小值，按结构板上的覆土深度计。[C26]

Fences, storage, lighting围栏、储藏与照明

Non-climbable perimeter fences keep children in and strangers from reaching or climbing in. Provide ample weatherproof, lit, lockable outdoor storage for each group’s play area, and outdoor lighting on photocells so the areas can be used on darker winter days — solar powered and/or LED lights are highly encouraged. Fence heights and openings:不可攀爬的周边围栏把孩子留在里面、让陌生人够不到也爬不进来。每个班的游乐区配充足的防风雨、带照明、可上锁的室外储藏；室外照明接光感自动控制，使游乐区在冬季较暗的日子也能用——高度鼓励太阳能和／或 LED 灯。围栏高度与开口：

Heights are minimums; the openings limit applies to every fence.高度都是最低值；开口限制适用于所有围栏。[C23]

Suitable trees · Table 4: Suitable Trees for Rooftop Outdoor Play Areas适合的树木 · 表 4：屋顶室外游乐区适种树木

For rooftop play areas, §4.3.2 J points to small trees that give shade and colour in rooftop planters: “Suggested suitable small deciduous trees for shade and colour, suitable for rooftop planters are shown in Table 4.” The full table (PDF p. 28) lists 13 trees with their light exposure. Rooftop planting in general should use wind tolerant and drought-resistant trees and plants, and trees need at least 900 mm of growing medium. Before planting anything, also check it against the toxic plant list (Appendix J — full list on Page 4): a tree can be the right size and still be the wrong species.屋顶游乐区种什么树，原书 §4.3.2 J 给了明确清单：适合屋顶种植池、能遮阴又添色彩的小乔木见表 4。全表（PDF 第 28 页）共 13 种，并逐种标了光照要求。屋顶种植总体还要选耐风、耐旱的树种与植物，乔木覆土至少 900 mm。种任何植物之前，还要对照有毒植物清单核 1 遍（附录 J——完整清单在页 4）：尺寸合适，不等于品种安全。[C50][C26]

Botanical name学名Common name常用名Exposure光照
Acer campestreHedge Maple · 栓皮槭Sun to light shade全日照到轻微遮阴
Acer circinatumVine Maple · 藤槭Part shade半阴
Acer griseumPaper bark Maple · 血皮槭Part shade半阴
Acer japonicumJapanese Maple · 羽扇槭Part shade半阴
Acer palmatumSmooth Japanese Maple · 鸡爪槭Part shade半阴
Cornus kousa HybridsKousa Dogwood ‘Aurora’, ‘Celestine’, and ‘Starlight’ · 四照花杂交种Sun to light shade全日照到轻微遮阴
Cercis canadensisRedbud · 加拿大紫荆Sun to light shade全日照到轻微遮阴
Magnolia stellata ‘Royal Star’‘Royal Star’ Star Magnolia · 星花木兰Sun to light shade全日照到轻微遮阴
Parrotia persicaPersian Ironwood · 波斯铁木Sun to light shade全日照到轻微遮阴
Pyrus calleryana ‘Chanticleer’‘Chanticleer’ Flowering Pear · 豆梨Sun to light shade全日照到轻微遮阴
Styrax japonicusJapanese Snowbell tree · 日本安息香Sun to light shade全日照到轻微遮阴
Pinus contortaShore Pine · 海岸松Sun全日照
Picea omorikaSerbian Spruce · 塞尔维亚云杉Sun全日照

Reading the table: the exposure column falls into 3 bands — Sun (2 conifers), Sun to light shade (7 trees), and Part shade (4 trees, all maples). Match the tree to the planter’s actual light, not the other way round.这张表的读法：光照只有 3 档——全日照 2 种（都是针叶树）、全日照到轻微遮阴 7 种、半阴 4 种（全是槭属）。按种植池的实际光照选树，不要反过来。[C50]

Guess first, then check先猜再看

Guess first: how deep must the sand be in a 3–5 group sandbox?先猜：3–5 组沙坑的沙至少要多深？

Answer: 18 in. for 3–5 group care and preschool groups — 12 in. is the infant/toddler figure.答案：3–5 团体与学前班为 18 in——12 in 是婴幼儿的数字。[C20]

Guess first: what is the Infant NET OUTDOOR AREA?先猜：Infant 班的净室外面积是多少？

Answer: activity areas 969 plus Outdoor Storage 86 gives a NET OUTDOOR AREA of 1,055 ft².答案：活动区 969 加室外储藏 86，净室外 1,055 ft²。[A2]

Guess first: what is the licensing floor for outdoor area per child?先猜：室外面积的省许可底线是每孩多少？

Answer: licensing is set at 65 ft² (6 m²) per child; the City requires 75 ft² as a minimum.答案：省许可底线 65 ft²（6 m²）／孩；市要求最低 75 ft²。[S1]

Can you answer these?你答得上来吗

Q: At the winter solstice, how much sunlight should outdoor play areas get?问：冬至日，室外游乐区应获得多少日照？

At least three hours per day at the winter solstice, two hours during the typical playtimes of 9:30–11:30 am or 1:30–4:00 pm.冬至每天至少 3 小时，其中 2 小时在上午 9:30–11:30 或下午 1:30–4:00 的典型游乐时段内。[C19]

Q: What is the climbing-equipment height standard for school-age children?问：学龄儿童的攀爬设备高度标准是多少？

School-Age Children: 7.5 ft. (Toddlers 3 ft.; Preschoolers 5 ft.)学龄儿童 7.5 ft（幼儿 3 ft、学前儿童 5 ft）。[C21]

Q: How large is the Covered Area for a 3–5 years group outdoors?问：3–5 岁班室外有盖区有多大？

3–5 outdoor: Covered 628, Open 1,256; 323 ft² is the Infant covered area.3–5 岁室外：有盖 628、露天 1,256；323 ft² 是 Infant 的有盖区。[A3]

Q: What is the NET OUTDOOR AREA of a 24-child School Age program?问：24 人学龄项目的净室外面积是多少？

Covered 603 + Open 1,205 = 1,808, plus Storage 86 gives 1,894 ft²; 1,618 ft² is its net indoor area.有盖 603＋露天 1,205＝1,808，再加储藏 86，净室外 1,894 ft²；1,618 ft² 是它的净室内面积。[B3]

§5.0 · Facility Technical Considerations — Overview§5.0 · 技术考虑总览（Facility Technical Considerations）

Section 5.0 is the technical half of the book. This page is only its doorway: the subsection directory below, in the book’s own order. The requirements themselves live on the three section pages that follow — nothing is summarised or re-numbered here.§5.0 是原书的技术部分。本页只是它的入口：下面按原书顺序列出小节目录，要求正文在随后 3 个分节页里——这里不概述、不另编编号。

The subsections of §5.0, in the book’s order§5.0 的小节目录（按原书顺序）

5.1 · Purpose5.1 · 目的 Purpose

The first subsection of §5.0 in the book’s contents. This site carries no separate page for it; the requirements that follow it are carried by the §5.3 pages below.原书目录中 §5.0 的第 1 小节。本站未为它单设页面；其后的要求正文由下面 §5.3 的分节页承载。

5.2 · Applicable Regulations5.2 · 适用法规 Applicable Regulations

The second subsection of §5.0 in the book’s contents. This site carries no separate page for it; governing legislation and bylaws prevail over the Guidelines throughout this site.原书目录中 §5.0 的第 2 小节。本站未为它单设页面；本站通篇口径一致：上位法例与附例优先于本指引。

5.3 · The technical requirements, on three pages5.3 · 技术要求，本站分 3 页

Construction and finishes first, then the rooms, then the building systems:先构造与饰面，再逐间房，最后建筑系统：

§5.3.1–5.3.8 · Construction and Finishes →§5.3.1–5.3.8 · 构造与饰面 → §5.3.9 · Room Considerations →§5.3.9 · 逐间房要求 → §5.3.12–5.3.13 · Mechanical & Electrical →§5.3.12–5.3.13 · 机电与控制 →

§5.3.1–5.3.8 · Construction and Finishes§5.3.1–5.3.8 · 构造与饰面

Section 5.0’s technical considerations exist to be read with the design considerations of Section 4.0: they outline construction, material and building-system requirements, give an early cost-estimating tool, and act as the consultants’ checklist. This page covers construction and finishes; §5.3.9’s room-by-room rules are on the §5.3.9 page, and the systems sections are on the §5.3.12–5.3.13 page.原书 §5.0 技术考量要与 §4.0 设计考量合读：它列出构造、材料与建筑系统的要求，可作早期估价工具，也是顾问的核对清单。本页收构造与饰面（§5.3.1–5.3.8）；§5.3.9 的逐间房规则在 §5.3.9 页，系统部分在 §5.3.12–5.3.13 页。

Construction and envelope构造与围护

Floor-to-floor height层高（楼面到楼面）

The extra depth between ceiling and slab is what leaves room for the mechanical and electrical equipment.多出的这段深度，就是留给机电设备的空间。[C24]

Exterior concrete finishes室外混凝土饰面

Shape every exposed concrete edge with the chamfer shown; pavements and sidewalks get the light broom finish.所有外露混凝土边缘按图倒角；铺地与人行道做轻扫面。[C25]

Windows in the envelope围护中的窗

Doors and windows to meet CAN/CSA-A440 standards; provide screens on all operable windows; watch solar heat gain (overhangs, shading structures or special glazing); typically, all glazing is tempered. The sill and opening dimensions:门窗须符合 CAN/CSA-A440；所有可开启窗配纱窗；注意太阳能增益（挑檐、遮阳构造或特殊玻璃）；通常所有玻璃为钢化。窗台与开启尺寸：

Sill heights let children look out and see their surroundings; restrictors limit the opening dimension.窗台高度让孩子能看出去；限位器把开启尺寸限住。[C27]

Roofing guarantees屋面保证

Provide roof edge safety barriers, fall protection and fall arrest as per the BC Building Code and WorkSafe requirements; consider an electronic leak detection system below occupied roofs, connected to DDC. The two guarantees, from the certified date of Total Performance:按 BCBC 与 WorkSafe 要求提供屋面边缘安全屏障、防坠落与坠落制动；可考虑在有占用屋面下设电子漏检系统并接入 DDC。2 项保证，自工程 Total Performance 认证日起算：

Two clocks run from the same start date — the membrane’s is twice as long.2 个时钟同日起算——膜厂家的那项长 1 倍。[C26r]

Heating the floor over unheated space非采暖空间之上的楼面

If the floor of a child care facility is over an unheated space, consider the use of in-floor radiant heating loops set into a concrete floor topping, or increase the insulation R-values in the floor system beyond that required by the Building Code or ASHRAE 90.1 standards.若托儿设施楼面位于非采暖空间之上，考虑在混凝土面层内埋地暖盘管，或把楼面系统保温 R 值提高到超过规范或 ASHRAE 90.1 的要求。

Building systems, briefly建筑系统（略述）

If not a stand-alone facility, the child care facility should have its own HVAC systems, separate from the rest of the building, with filters and maintenance items easily accessible. All units must be accessed without temporary scaffolding or lift equipment; no units are installed in nap room ceilings; and the cooling tower is designed and maintained per ASHRAE guidance to minimize the risk of legionella. Acoustic design should protect the facility from external and adjacent-occupancy noise, considering STC ratings above Code.非独立设施时，托儿部分应有自己的暖通系统、与建筑其余部分分开，过滤器与维护件易于接近。所有机组须无需临时脚手架或升降设备即可检修；午睡房天花内不装机组；冷却塔按 ASHRAE 指引设计维护以降低军团菌风险。声学设计要隔绝外部与相邻占用噪声，可考虑高于规范的 STC 等级。

Floors, walls, ceilings, doors, millwork地面、墙面、天花、门与木作

Floors地面

Provide walk-off mats at entries, and floor drains in all washrooms, the janitor’s room, the laundry room, the garbage room and the mechanical room. Resilient flooring (smooth, non-absorbent, non-slip, washable) is required in kitchens, washrooms, laundry, janitorial closets, art areas, table areas and entry/cubby areas — sheet vinyl, not tiles, with welded seams. Carpet goes in nap rooms, quiet rooms, staff rooms and offices (neutral-coloured carpet tile preferred in nap and quiet rooms). The two build-up dimensions:入口设刮泥垫；所有洗手间、清洁间、洗衣房、垃圾房与机械房设地漏。厨房、洗手间、洗衣、清洁柜、美术区、桌椅区与入口／储物柜区须用弹性地面（光滑、不吸水、防滑、可清洗）——卷材乙烯基、不要瓷砖，焊缝处理。午睡房、安静室、员工室与办公室铺地毯（午睡与安静室首选素色方块毯）。2 处构造尺寸：

Base is rubber and continuous throughout; the carpet underlay has a minimum thickness.踢脚用橡胶、通长连续；地毯垫层有最小厚度。[C28]

Walls and partitions墙面与隔断

Painted drywall is the typical finish; use low VOC paints and sealants, and mould and mildew resistant paints in kitchens and washrooms. Ensure no sharp corners within child height — rounded/curved corner guards are preferred — and provide backing in walls to secure millwork, railings and fittings. Gloss levels: G5 (semi-gloss) for kitchen, washrooms, laundry, janitor’s room and all doors, frames and trims; G3 (eggshell) typical for walls, matte finishes not acceptable. In activity areas, wall protection runs up the wall:典型饰面是油漆石膏板；用低 VOC 油漆与密封剂，厨房与洗手间用防霉抗霉漆。儿童高度内不得有尖角——首选圆弧护角；墙内预埋背衬以固定木作、扶手与配件。光泽等级：厨房、洗手间、洗衣、清洁间及所有门、门框与线条用 G5（半光）；墙面一般用 G3（蛋壳光），哑光不可接受。活动区的墙面防撞层高度：

Protection paneling is recommended in activity areas, at the height shown.活动区建议做防撞板，高度如图所示。[C29]

Ceilings天花

Acoustic T-Bar ceilings are preferred in activity rooms, nap rooms and cubby areas — commercial quality, 75% T-bar with NRC .70 or better, with access for above-ceiling services except in nap rooms. Finished interior ceiling at a preferred 3 m (10 ft.) height; if higher and accepted by the City, additional acoustic treatment is required. All kitchens and washrooms to have washable ceilings; drywall ceiling in all areas/rooms that have showers.活动室、午睡房与储物柜区首选声学 T 型龙骨天花——商业品质，75% T-bar、NRC .70 或更好；除午睡房外要留天花上服务检修口。完成天花首选高度 3 m（10 ft）；更高且经市府接受时须加声学处理。厨房与洗手间天花须可清洗；有淋浴的房间用石膏板天花。[C30]

Doors and hardware门与五金

Doors into any area should be glazed with tempered and laminated glass, so small children can see through. Hardware to be commercial grade and meet accessibility and universal design requirements; do not install door closers unless required by Code; door stops typically wall-mounted; sliding doors must be pinnable in place; swing doors to gross motor/nap rooms and outdoor play areas get “elephant’s foot” or similar hold-open devices; kick plates on the push side of doors with closers and at all storage room doors. Avoid anything that creates “pinching” or scraping hazards, such as door grilles.进入任何区域的门应镶钢化夹胶玻璃，让小个子儿童也能透视。五金用商业级、符合无障碍与通用设计要求；非规范要求不装闭门器；门挡一般装墙上；推拉门须能销定；通往大运动／午睡房与室外游乐区的平开门配「象脚」或类似持开装置；带闭门器的门推侧与所有储藏室门配踢脚板。避免任何造成「夹伤」或刮伤隐患的装置，如门格栅。

Millwork木作

All millwork to meet AWMAC requirements and the City-as-future-owner standard for child care facilities. Upper shelves to have a latch (for closed cabinets) or lip (for open cabinets) for earthquake safety measures. Millwork is not to be counted in licensed useable space calculations. Cabinet doors must open wide:所有木作须符合 AWMAC 要求与市府「未来业主」的托儿设施标准。上层搁板：封闭柜配门闩、开放柜配挡边，作地震安全措施。木作不计入持牌可用面积计算。柜门开启角度：

Every cabinet door opens at least to the angle shown.每个柜门至少开到图示角度。[C31]

Locks and gates, in brief锁与小门（略述）

The book’s Table 5 sets lock functions by location (Classroom, Office, Dummy, Passage, Privacy, Storeroom/Storage and Secure Gate Latch types). Gates at children’s washroom, kitchen and cubby area are half height, glazed (tempered), on a heavy duty piano hinge for the full height of the gate, with child-proof latches and no pinch points. The main door uses an electric strike with card reader outside, easy exit hardware inside, and a power assist door operator for accessibility.原书 Table 5 按位置定锁功能（Classroom、Office、Dummy、Passage、Privacy、Storeroom/Storage、Secure Gate Latch 等类型）。儿童洗手间、厨房与储物柜区的小门为半高、镶（钢化）玻璃、用全高重型长铰链，配儿童安全闩且无夹点。正门外侧用电锁扣加读卡器、内侧用易操作出口五金，并配助力开门器作无障碍。

Ceilings (§5.3.6)天花（§5.3.6）

Painted drywall is one potential ceiling finish, but it can create a noisy interior environment. Acoustic T-bar ceilings are preferred in activity rooms, nap rooms and cubby areas.涂装石膏板是 1 种可选的天花饰面，但容易让室内变吵。活动室、午睡房与储物柜区首选声学 T-bar 天花。[G1]

  • Acoustic T-bar: install commercial quality; use low VOC paints and sealants (refer to gloss levels in Section 5.3.5).声学 T-bar：装商用级；用低 VOC 油漆与密封剂（光泽等级见 §5.3.5）。
  • Provide access for above-ceiling services, except in nap rooms.留吊顶内设备检修口——午睡房除外。
  • Finished interior ceiling to be at a preferred 3 m (10 ft.) height, to reduce noise, to be child friendly and for ease of maintenance; should the ceiling be higher and accepted by the City, additional acoustic treatment is required.完成天花优选高 3 m（10 ft）——为降噪、对儿童友好并便于维护；更高且经市府接受时，须加声学处理。
  • 75% T-bar with NRC .70 or better.75% T-bar，NRC .70 或更好。

All kitchens and washrooms to have washable ceilings (can be tiles). Provide drywall ceiling in all areas/rooms that have showers.厨房与洗手间用可清洗天花（可用瓷砖）。有淋浴的所有区域／房间用石膏板天花。[G1]

Doors and hardware (§5.3.7)门与五金（§5.3.7）

Doors门

Doors into any area should be glazed with tempered and laminated glass — the intent is to allow for visibility through glazing in doors by small children. If accordion doors are installed, ensure they have appropriate mid-door supports and are easy for staff to manoeuvre, lock and unlock. Avoid any installations that create “pinching” or scraping hazards, such as door grilles. Doors are to meet AWMAC standards.进入任何区域的门应镶钢化夹胶玻璃——目的是让小个子儿童也能透过门上玻璃看出去。装折叠门时，须配适当的中部门撑，并让员工容易推拉、上锁与开锁。避免任何造成「夹伤」或刮伤隐患的装置，如门格栅。门须符合 AWMAC 标准。[G2]

Hardware五金

Hardware should be commercial grade, and meet accessibility and universal design requirements. Do not install door closers unless required by Code; door stops are typically wall-mounted; sliding doors must be pinnable in place so they cannot slide unsupervised; swing doors to gross motor/nap rooms and outdoor play areas get an “elephant’s foot” or similar hold-open device; kick plates go on the push side of doors with closers and at all storeroom doors; all hinges get system screw mounting plates.五金用商业级，符合无障碍与通用设计要求。非规范要求不装闭门器；门挡多为墙装；推拉门须可销固，防止无人看管时滑动；通往大运动／午睡房与室外游乐区的平开门配「象脚」或类似持开装置；带闭门器的门在推侧、以及所有储藏室门配踢脚板；所有铰链配系统螺钉安装板。[G2]

Gates (half-height doors)半高门／栅门

Children’s washrooms, the kitchen and the cubby area use half-height glazed (tempered) gates, hung on a full-height piano hinge, with no pinch points and child locks (bankers locks).儿童洗手间、厨房与储物柜区用半高镶（钢化）玻璃栅门，挂全高钢琴铰链，无夹点，配儿童锁（bankers lock）。[G2]

Main door and lock functions正门与锁功能

The main door uses an electric strike with a card reader outside, easy-to-operate exit hardware inside, and a power-assist door operator for accessibility. Table 5 sets the lock function by location — seven types: Classroom, Office, Dummy, Passage, Privacy, Storeroom/Storage and Secure Gate Latch.正门外侧用电锁扣加读卡器、内侧用易操作出口五金，并配无障碍助力开门器。原书 Table 5 按位置定锁功能——共 7 种：Classroom、Office、Dummy、Passage、Privacy、Storeroom/Storage、Secure Gate Latch。[G2]

Guess first, then check先猜再看

Guess first: what is the minimum interior floor-to-floor height?先猜：室内楼面到楼面的最小高度是多少？

Answer: minimum 3.66 m (12 ft.) floor to floor, keeping at least 3 m (10 ft.) clear ceiling height.答案：楼面到楼面最小 3.66 m（12 ft），并保持至少 3 m（10 ft）净天花高。[C24]

Guess first: how high must wall protection paneling run above the floor?先猜：墙面防撞板至少要做到多高？

Answer: Appendix L sets wall protection at a minimum of 36 in.; 60 in. is the blind-cord clearance.答案：附录 L 规定墙面防撞层至少 36 in；60 in 是窗帘绳的距地要求。[B5]

Guess first: how high must the backsplash be at washrooms and kitchens?先猜：洗手间与厨房的挡水板至少多高？

Answer: backsplashes at washrooms and kitchens are at least 4 in.; 24 in. is the art-sink backsplash.答案：洗手间与厨房挡水板至少 4 in；24 in 是美术水槽的挡水板。[B5]

Can you answer these?你答得上来吗

Q: Which two guarantees does the roofing section require?问：屋面部分要求哪 2 项保证？

A 10 year roof membrane manufacturers guarantee (RCABC), plus a written Contractor’s Labour and Materials Guarantee for sixty (60) months — five (5) years.10 年屋面膜厂家保证（RCABC），外加承包商人工与材料书面保证 60 个月（5 年）。[C26r]

Q: How high off the floor should the bottom window sill be, so children can look out?问：为让孩子能向外看，下窗台应距地多高？

Bottom sill approximately 18 in. to 2 ft. off the floor — with restrictors limiting the opening to 4 in.下窗台距地约 18 in 到 2 ft——且限位器把开启限于 4 in。[C27]

Q: How high must the backsplash be at an art sink?问：美术水槽的挡水板至少多高？

Art sinks get a backsplash of at least 24 in.; washrooms and kitchens need only 4 in.美术水槽挡水板至少 24 in；洗手间与厨房只需 4 in。[B5]

Q: How far above the floor must the bottom of a blind cord hang?问：窗帘绳下端至少距地多高？

Appendix L requires blind cords to end at least 60 in. above the floor; 36 in. is the wall-protection height.附录 L 要求窗帘绳下端距地至少 60 in；36 in 是墙面防撞层高度。[B5]
