§5.3.9 · Room Considerations — with the Appendix K Definitions§5.3.9 · 逐间房要求（附录 K 定义在本页）

Room by room: washrooms and the diaper change area, the kitchen, the gross motor and nap room, the art area, laundry, cubbies, staff office, storage and the janitor room — with all ten of the book’s room diagrams, Figures 3–12. Tap any diagram to enlarge it. A closing section collects Appendix K’s own definitions of the 7 space groups, A–G.逐间房看：洗手间与换尿布区、厨房、大运动与午睡房、美术区、洗衣房、储物柜、员工办公室、储藏与清洁间——附原书全部 10 张逐间简图 Figure 3–12。点击任意简图放大。章末一节系统收录附录 K 对 A–G 共 7 组空间的定义。

Children’s Washrooms and the Diaper Change Area儿童洗手间与换尿布区

Partitions, counters, accessories隔断、台面与配件

Toilet partitions: plastic laminate covered high density particle board, metal with baked enamel finish, or phenolic; hardware heavy duty stainless steel with tamperproof screws. Countertops: plastic laminate with a large-size ceramic tile backsplash and darker coloured anti-microbial epoxy grout preferred. Recessed accessories are typically preferred, and mirrors over children’s sinks are required.马桶隔断：塑料层压高密度刨花板、烤漆金属或酚醛板；五金用重型不锈钢配防拆螺丝。台面：塑料层压面配大尺寸瓷砖挡水板、深色抗菌环氧填缝为佳。配件一般首选嵌入式；儿童水槽上方必须装镜子。

Plumbing in the children’s washroom儿童洗手间的给排水

Regular tank style water closets with round bowls — small or “baby” child size toilets are not recommended — with closed front (“residential”) toilet seats without lids. Sinks are self-rimming drop-in vanity sinks; faucets to have aerators and temperature control (120 degree F maximum) with mixing valves; a two handle fixed spout faucet is required.常规水箱式马桶、圆座——不推荐小号或「婴儿」儿童马桶——配无盖的闭合前沿（住宅式）座圈。水槽为自带边嵌入式台盆；龙头配起泡器与温控（最高 120 °F）及混水阀；须用双柄固定出水龙头。[R4]

Diaper Change Area换尿布区

Change table millwork cabinet with space for steps and an opening in the countertop to access a disposal bin. Provide storage above the diaper change area and above toilets (without creating headroom issues). Lighting must not shine directly into children’s eyes, cast shadows on the child being diapered, or create excessive heat. The two working dimensions:换台柜带放台阶的空间、台面开孔通向垃圾桶。换尿布区与马桶上方设储物（不得造成碰头问题）。照明不得直射孩子眼睛、不得在换尿布的孩子身上投下阴影、不得产生过多热量。2 个工作尺寸：

The single-compartment sink is deep; the cabinet above clears the counter by the distance shown.单槽水槽够深；上方吊柜与台面之间留出图示距离。[R2][C32]

Washrooms by program type (Appendix K)按项目类型分的洗手间（附录 K）

For under-36-months groups: a dedicated diapering area with everything within the caregiver’s reach, a changing surface with an adjacent sink, storage for clean and soiled laundry, and an accessible, lockable stair set for children to reach the changing surface. For 30 months to school age: a washroom immediately accessible from the cubby and activity areas, its entrance visually supervisable by staff, plus a large accessible-size enclosed stall with a door that can serve as a diapering area. For school age: individual stalls with doors, for older children’s privacy. All washrooms and service rooms must have floor drains.36 个月以下组：专用换尿布区，所有东西在照顾者手边可及；换台面旁配水槽，备洁净与脏污衣物存放；给孩子上换台的可达、可上锁台阶组。30 个月到学龄组：洗手间须从储物柜区与活动区直接可达，入口可被员工目视看护；另设 1 个带门的大号无障碍隔间可用作换尿布区。学龄组：带门的独立隔间，保障大孩子隐私。所有洗手间与服务间必须设地漏。

The Kitchen厨房

Appliances设备

Appliances to be “Energy Star” rated. A kitchen serving child care program(s) with more than 25 children in total: provide a commercial style under-counter dishwasher with a sani-cycle. Fridge and freezer unit required; a second fridge is recommended in shared kitchens; an additional freezer if the child care provides a lunch program. 30 in. wide 4 burner stove with oven, controls out of reach of children. Range hood directly venting to the outdoors — carbon filters are not acceptable. Microwave oven: 2.0 cu.ft. and 1,100 watt minimum.设备须「Energy Star」评级。服务总人数超过 25 名儿童的厨房：配带消毒程序的商用台下洗碗机。冰箱与冷冻柜必需；共用厨房建议第 2 台冰箱；若提供午餐项目再加 1 台冷冻柜。30 in 宽 4 头炉带烤箱，控制钮在儿童够不到处。抽油烟机直接排到室外——碳过滤不可接受。微波炉：最小 2.0 cu.ft.、1,100 watt。[C33]

Millwork, plumbing, compliance木作、给排水与合规

Plywood carcass construction; finished countertop with all outside corners eased; no gaps in the countertops. For 30 Months to School Age programs, provide a child height breakfast counter (25 in.) between the kitchen and the activity area so children can observe kitchen activities. Plumbing: a double bowl stainless steel kitchen sink and a separate stainless steel hand sink. All kitchens must comply with the National Food Code and Provincial Food Premises Regulations, as well as the BC Building Code.柜体用胶合板构造；台面外角全倒圆；台面不得有缝隙。30 个月到学龄项目：在厨房与活动区之间设儿童高度早餐台（25 in），让孩子能观察厨房活动。给排水：双槽不锈钢厨房水槽，外加独立的不锈钢洗手槽。所有厨房须符合 National Food Code、省级 Food Premises Regulations 与 BCBC。[C33]

Warming kitchen vs. commercial kitchen (Appendix K)加热厨房与商业厨房（附录 K）

Kitchens serving a maximum of 37 children, with no hot meal program, are typically equipped as a “warming kitchen” — residential style stove with inaccessible operation knobs at the back, a microwave, a double sink and separate hand sink, and a dishwasher; no grease-laden cooking vapours are permitted. Kitchens serving over 37 children or used to cook hot meals may be required to provide a commercial kitchen exhaust hood with fire suppression.服务不超过 37 名儿童、且无热餐项目的厨房，通常按「加热厨房」配置——住宅式炉（操作钮在后方、儿童够不到）、微波炉、双槽水槽与独立洗手槽、洗碗机；不允许产生油脂烹饪蒸气。服务超过 37 名儿童或要做热餐的厨房，可能须配带消防抑制的商业厨房排烟罩。[C41]

Nap room, art area, laundry, cubbies, storage午睡房、美术区、洗衣房、储物柜与储藏

Gross Motor and Nap Room (§5.3.9 C + Appendix K D)大运动与午睡房（§5.3.9 C ＋ 附录 K D）

Glazed doors and windows in laminated tempered glass; elephant foot hold-opens on doors; blackout blinds on the nap room side. Provide an earthquake safe shelf for music equipment, and do not locate shelves above cribs. For under-36-months groups, separate nap rooms are recommended: one for cribs and one for mats or cots. There is no nap requirement for preschool or school age programs; a gross motor room is needed. For group care (30 months to school age), the room is sized for 25 children sleeping on mats:门窗玻璃用夹胶钢化；门配象脚持开；午睡房 1 侧装遮光帘。设地震安全的乐器设备架；婴儿床上方不得设搁板。36 个月以下组：建议分开 2 间午睡房，1 间放婴儿床、1 间放睡垫或小床。学前班与学龄项目无午睡要求，但需要大运动房。30 个月到学龄组，房间按 25 名儿童睡垫 sizing：

Each child gets a 2 ft. x 4 ft. mat; the 2 ft. gaps are circulation, not spare floor.每孩 1 张 2 ft × 4 ft 垫；2 ft 间隔是通行，不是空地。[C39]

Art Area (§5.3.9 D)美术区（§5.3.9 D）

Art sink: stainless steel complete with faucet ledge, 10 in. deep (deep enough to also allow washing of toys), a floor-mounted sediment trap accessible for clean-out, temperature control for hot water (120 degrees F maximum), and consider a second, lower art sink for children. Millwork: drying racks or shelves for wet paintings, and closed upper and lower cabinets.美术水槽：不锈钢带龙头台面，10 in 深（须深到能洗玩具），落地式沉淀隔并可达清理，热水温控（最高 120 °F），并可再设 1 个更低的儿童水槽。木作：湿画晾干架或搁板、封闭式上下柜。[C34][R3]

Laundry Room (§5.3.9 E + Appendix K)洗衣房（§5.3.9 E ＋ 附录 K）

Provide a 10 in. deep stainless steel laundry sink in counter; standard temperature hot water (the room is not accessible to children); side-by-side washer/dryer hook-up preferred. Combination units are not acceptable; stackable units may be used providing they are seismically restrained. Front loading washers and dryers must be in an enclosed, lockable space or behind a safety gate. A laundry room is typically about 40 ft² in size, ideally near the infant and toddler washroom; it must be lockable, with larger-capacity, heavy duty rated appliances.台面内设 10 in 深不锈钢洗衣槽；标准温度热水（该房儿童不可进入）；洗衣机／干衣机并排接口为佳。组合机不可接受；叠放机可用但须抗震固定。前开门洗衣干衣机必须放在封闭可锁空间内或安全门后。洗衣房通常约 40 ft²，理想靠近婴幼儿洗手间；必须可上锁，设备用大容量、重型评级。[C35][C42]

Cubbies: count and hooks (§5.3.9 F + Appendix K B)储物柜：数量与挂钩（§5.3.9 F ＋ 附录 K B）

The cubby area also needs enough space for one staff and eight children to get dressed for outdoor play in inclement weather. Millwork: provide 3 coat hooks per cubby; the boot shelf at the bottom is best designed with recessed side walls for ease of cleaning; overhead cabinets require a security latch. Personal storage baskets for each child are typically stored in each cubby on an upper shelf. The count rule:储物柜区还要留出 1 名员工带 8 名孩子在坏天气穿户外装备的空间。木作：每个 cubby 配 3 个衣钩；底部靴架侧墙做内凹便于清洁；吊柜须配安全闩。每孩的个人收纳篮通常放在各自 cubby 的上层搁板。数量规则：

One per child is the base count — the extra tenth is deliberate slack.每孩 1 个是基数——多出的 1/10 是刻意留的余量。[C38][C36]

Entry (Appendix K A)入口（附录 K A）

Provide one means of entry only, supervised by staff with an alarm signaling unauthorized entry or exit; additional entry and exit doors must also be alarmed. Provide the entry directly from the outdoors where possible, with universal accessibility, space for strollers and car or booster seats, a sign-in counter for parents, and a space for parents to leave their shoes. In new buildings, vestibules at entries are required for energy conservation — best as glass enclosures with automatic opening doors operated by push plates, without compromising surveillance of the front entry.只设 1 个出入口，由员工看护并配未经授权进出报警；其余出入与出口门也须报警。入口尽量直接从室外进入，全程无障碍；留婴儿车与汽车／增高座椅存放、家长签到台，以及家长放鞋的位置。新建筑入口须设门斗以节能——最好是玻璃围合并配压板自动门，且不得削弱对正门的看护。

Activity Room and Quiet Room (Appendix K C, E)活动室与安静室（附录 K C、E）

The area of the activity room is based on a minimum of 40 ft² per child, devoted to children’s activities — not including circulation through the room or built-in millwork. Ceilings of at least ten feet from floor to finished ceiling are beneficial, rather than the standard eight feet. The quiet room is a separate room or area with a door for quiet activities involving one staff and up to three children, generally adjacent the activity room, with glass partitions to allow visual surveillance in and out.活动室面积按每孩最低 40 ft² 计算，专供儿童活动——不含穿行流线与内置木作。天花从地面到完成面至少 10 英尺有益，优于标准 8 英尺。安静室是独立成间或带门的区域，供 1 名员工带最多 3 名孩子做安静活动，一般紧邻活动室，配玻璃隔断以便内外目视看护。[S2][C40]

Storage, staff office, janitor (Appendix K G)储藏、员工办公室、清洁间（附录 K G）

Six typical storage categories: active, semi-active (overhead storage must have ledge or latching for earthquake safety), storage room, sleeping mat or cot storage (purpose-built millwork; mats must not touch each other; each child’s bedding kept separate), stroller storage near the entry, and emergency supply storage (shelving secured for seismic restraint, with a sealed “comfort kit” for each child). The administrative office should seat one person per program at the same time, with double tier half-lockers preferred for staff. The janitor’s room is a locked utility area of a minimum 40 ft², with mop sink, floor drain and shelving. A sleep mat is 3 in. thick x 24 in. deep x 48 in. long, with a washable cover.6 类典型储藏：日常、半日常（高处储物须有挡边或闩扣作地震安全）、储藏室、睡垫或小床储藏（专用木作；垫子不得互相接触；每孩寝具分开存放）、入口附近的婴儿车储藏、应急物资储藏（搁板抗震固定，每孩 1 份密封「comfort kit」）。行政办公室应能同时坐下每个项目各 1 人，员工储物柜首选双层半高柜。清洁间是可上锁的杂务间，最小 40 ft²，配拖把槽、地漏与搁板。单张睡垫尺寸：3 in 厚 × 24 in 深 × 48 in 长，配可洗罩面。[C42][C37]

Appendix K · Definitions of Each Space (A–G)附录 K · 各空间定义（A–G）

Appendix K (PDF pp. 77–79) defines each program and support space in its own section, A–G. The 7 cards below collect those definitions in the book’s order; the numbers embedded in the appendix are cited as [K2].附录 K（PDF 第 77–79 页）按 A–G 逐节定义每个项目空间与支持空间。下面 7 张卡按原书顺序收齐这些定义；附录内嵌的数字以 [K2] 标出。[K1][K2]

A. The EntryA. 入口

Provide one means of entry only, supervised by staff, with an alarm signaling unauthorized entry or exit; additional entry and exit doors must also be alarmed. Provide the entry directly from the outdoors where possible, with universal accessibility, space for strollers and car or booster seats, a sign-in counter for parents, and a space for parents to leave their shoes. In new buildings, vestibules at entries are required for energy conservation — best as glass enclosures with automatic opening doors operated by push plates, without compromising surveillance of the front entry.只设 1 个出入口，由员工看护并配未经授权进出报警；其余出入与出口门也须报警。入口尽量直接从室外进入，全程无障碍；留婴儿车与汽车／增高座椅存放、家长签到台，以及家长放鞋的位置。新建筑入口须设门斗以节能——最好是玻璃围合并配压板自动门，且不得削弱对正门的看护。[K1]

B. The Cubby AreaB. 储物柜区

The cubby area is the children’s dressing and personal-storage area: it provides enough space for one staff and eight children to get dressed for outdoor play in inclement weather, and personal storage baskets for each child are typically stored in each cubby on an upper shelf.储物柜区是孩子的更衣与个人存放区：留出 1 名员工带 8 名孩子在坏天气穿户外装备的空间；每孩的个人收纳篮通常放在各自 cubby 的上层搁板。[K1]

Count: 1 cubby per child, plus 10% extra cubbies to accommodate part-time children.数量：每孩 1 个 cubby，外加 10% 备用，容纳非全日制儿童。[K2]

C. The Activity RoomC. 活动室

The area of the activity room is based on a minimum of 40 ft² per child, devoted to children’s activities — not including circulation through the room or built-in millwork. Ceilings of at least 10 ft from floor to finished ceiling are beneficial, rather than the standard 8 ft.活动室面积按每孩最低 40 ft² 计算，专供儿童活动——不含穿行流线与内置木作。天花从地面到完成面至少 10 ft 有益，优于标准 8 ft。[K1]

D. The Gross Motor and Nap RoomD. 大运动与午睡房

For under-36-months groups, separate nap rooms are recommended: one for cribs and one for mats or cots. There is no nap requirement for preschool or school age programs; a gross motor room is needed. For group care (30 months to school age), the room is sized for 25 children sleeping on mats.36 个月以下组：建议分开 2 间午睡房，1 间放婴儿床、1 间放睡垫或小床。学前班与学龄项目无午睡要求，但需要大运动房。30 个月到学龄组，房间按 25 名儿童睡垫定尺度。[K1]

Mats: a 2 ft × 4 ft sleeping mat for each child, plus 2 ft of circulation space between mats.睡垫：每孩 1 张 2 ft × 4 ft 睡垫，垫间留 2 ft 通行。[K2]

E. The Quiet RoomE. 安静室

The quiet room is a separate room or area with a door for quiet activities, generally adjacent to the activity room, with glass partitions to allow visual surveillance in and out.安静室是独立成间或带门的区域，供安静活动，一般紧邻活动室，配玻璃隔断以便内外目视看护。[K1]

Occupancy: 1 staff member with up to 3 children.人数：1 名员工带最多 3 名孩子。[K2]

F. The KitchenF. 厨房

Kitchens serving a maximum of 37 children, with no hot meal program, are typically equipped as a “warming kitchen” — residential style stove with inaccessible operation knobs at the back, a microwave, a double sink and separate hand sink, and a dishwasher; no grease-laden cooking vapours are permitted. Kitchens serving over 37 children or used to cook hot meals may be required to provide a commercial kitchen exhaust hood with fire suppression.服务不超过 37 名儿童、且无热餐项目的厨房，通常按「加热厨房」配置——住宅式炉（操作钮在后方、儿童够不到）、微波炉、双槽水槽与独立洗手槽、洗碗机；不允许产生油脂烹饪蒸气。服务超过 37 名儿童或要做热餐的厨房，可能须配带消防抑制的商业厨房排烟罩。[K1][K2]

G. Child Care Support SpacesG. 支持空间

Support spaces are the rooms that serve the program spaces. Appendix K covers them under one section:支持空间是服务于项目空间的房间，附录 K 用一节统述：[K1]

  • Storage — 6 categories: active; semi-active (overhead storage with a ledge or latching for earthquake safety); storage room; sleeping mat or cot storage (purpose-built millwork; mats must not touch each other; each child’s bedding kept separate); stroller storage near the entry; emergency supply storage (shelving secured for seismic restraint, with a sealed “comfort kit” for each child)储藏——6 类：日常；半日常（高处储物须有挡边或闩扣作地震安全）；储藏室；睡垫或小床储藏（专用木作；垫子不得互相接触；每孩寝具分开存放）；入口附近的婴儿车储藏；应急物资储藏（搁板抗震固定，每孩 1 份密封「comfort kit」应急包）
  • Children’s washrooms — arranged by program type (see the washroom section of this page); all washrooms and service rooms must have floor drains儿童洗手间——按项目类型配置（见本页洗手间一节）；所有洗手间与服务间必须设地漏
  • Accessible washroom and staff washroom — the staff washroom includes a shower无障碍洗手间与员工洗手间——员工洗手间带淋浴
  • Administration office — seats 1 person per program at the same time行政办公室——能同时坐下每个项目各 1 人
  • Staff room — double tier half-lockers preferred for staff员工休息室——员工储物柜首选双层半高柜
  • Parent room家长室
  • Laundry洗衣房
  • Janitor’s room清洁间
  • Garbage and recycling垃圾与回收
  • Service rooms — mechanical, electrical and IT (size based on equipment)设备间——机械、电气与 IT（面积按设备定）

Sizes given in Appendix K: a laundry room is typically about 40 ft², ideally near the infant and toddler washroom, and must be lockable; the janitor’s room is a locked utility area of a minimum 40 ft², with mop sink, floor drain and shelving.附录 K 给出的尺寸：洗衣房通常约 40 ft²，理想靠近婴幼儿洗手间，必须可上锁；清洁间是可上锁的杂务间，最小 40 ft²，配拖把槽、地漏与搁板。[K2]

Guess first, then check先猜再看

Guess first: beyond one cubby per child, how many extra cubbies does the book call for?先猜：除每孩 1 个 cubby 外，原书还要多备多少？

Answer: one cubby per child, plus 10% extra cubbies to accommodate part-time children.答案：每孩 1 个，外加 10% 备用，容纳非全日制儿童。[C38]

Guess first: what is the children's washroom counter height for children under 36 months?先猜：36 个月以下儿童的洗手台台面高是多少？

Answer: Appendix L sets the under-36-months washroom counter at 18–20 in.; 28–30 in. is the School Age figure.答案：附录 L 里 36 个月以下组洗手台高 18–20 in；28–30 in 是学龄组。[B5]

Guess first: how many litres is each garbage container the storage area is sized for?先猜：垃圾存放区按每只多少升的垃圾桶来配？

Answer: the garbage storage area must accommodate nine 240-litre containers.答案：垃圾存放区须容纳 9 只 240 升垃圾桶。[T10]

Can you answer these?你答得上来吗

Q: What are the minimum microwave specs for the kitchen?问：厨房微波炉的最低规格是？

Microwave oven: 2.0 cu.ft. and 1,100 watt minimum.微波炉：最小 2.0 cu.ft.、1,100 watt。[C33]

Q: A kitchen serving 30 children with no hot meal program is typically which kind — and what changes above 37 children?问：服务 30 名儿童、无热餐的厨房通常是哪 1 类——超过 37 名儿童时有什么变化？

Up to a maximum of 37 children with no hot meal program: a “warming kitchen”, no grease-laden vapours permitted. Over 37 children or cooking hot meals: a commercial kitchen exhaust hood with fire suppression may be required.不超过 37 名儿童且无热餐：是「加热厨房」，不许产生油脂蒸气。超过 37 名或做热餐：可能须配带消防抑制的商业厨房排烟罩。[C41]

Q: What must every art sink have?问：每个美术水槽必须配什么？

Provide a floor-mounted sediment trap for all art sinks, and temperature control for hot water (120 degrees F maximum).所有美术水槽须配落地沉淀隔，热水须控温（最高 120 °F）。[R3]

Q: What style of toilet is specified for children?问：儿童马桶指定什么样式？

Children's toilets to be tank style, with round bowls; fixture counts follow CCFL requirements.儿童马桶为水箱式圆座；洁具数量按 CCFL 要求。[R4]

Q: How does Appendix K define the Quiet Room?问：附录 K 怎样定义安静室？

Appendix K: the quiet room is a separate room or area with a door for quiet activities involving one staff and up to three children, generally adjacent the activity room, with glass partitions for visual surveillance.附录 K：安静室是独立成间或带门的区域，供 1 名员工带最多 3 名孩子做安静活动，一般紧邻活动室，配玻璃隔断以便目视看护。[K1][K2]

Q: In Appendix K, what does the Activity Room’s 40 ft² per child count — and what does it leave out?问：附录 K 里，活动室每孩 40 ft² 算什么、不算什么？

The area of the activity room is based on a minimum of 40 ft² per child, devoted to children’s activities — not including circulation through the room or built-in millwork.活动室面积按每孩最低 40 ft² 计算，专供儿童活动——不含穿行流线与内置木作。[K1]

§5.3.12–5.3.13 · Mechanical and Electrical Considerations§5.3.12–5.3.13 · 机电与控制（Mechanical and Electrical Considerations）

The systems chapter: HVAC and controls, plumbing, power, lighting levels, telephone/data, fire alarm and security — plus blinds and signage. The City’s named-model specifications (DDC contractors, MERV, flow rates) are collected on Page 4; this page keeps the body-text requirements.系统章：暖通与控制、给排水、电力、照度、电话／数据、消防报警与安防——外加窗帘与标识。市府点名型号的硬规格（DDC 承包商、MERV、流量）在页 4 汇总；本页收正文要求。

Mechanical: HVAC, controls, plumbing机械：暖通、控制、给排水

HVAC basics暖通基础

All rooms to be adequately ventilated (to meet ASHRAE 62); HVAC unit, equipment and system must be approved by the City. If baseboard heaters or radiators are used, ensure children cannot touch hot surfaces — all electric heaters or radiators to be ceiling mounted. Ductwork to be designed to avoid sound transmission; do not locate equipment in Nap Rooms. Provide a dedicated BTU meter for the child care facility’s HVAC system, and systems that monitor hydro, water and gas consumption separately from other building occupants.所有房间须充分通风（符合 ASHRAE 62）；暖通机组、设备与系统须经市府批准。用踢脚线加热器或散热器时，确保孩子摸不到热表面——所有电暖器或散热器装天花。风管设计要避免传声；设备不装在午睡房。为托儿设施的暖通设专用 BTU 计量表，并设可与建筑其他用户分开监测电、水、气用量的系统。

Controls: DDC and CO/CO₂ monitoring控制：DDC 与 CO/CO₂ 监测

Mechanical controls to be DDC, with the ability to tie into the City of Richmond’s Direct Digital Control networks (Appendix C), and the ability to individually control all rooms. Install permanent, hard-wired carbon dioxide and monoxide monitoring systems, in at minimum the activity rooms and the gross motor/nap rooms. Label all controls and ensure they are inaccessible to children; access control panels must be lockable and tamperproof.机械控制用 DDC，能接入市府的直接数字控制网络（附录 C），且每间房可独立控制。至少在活动室与大运动／午睡房装永久、硬接线的二氧化碳与一氧化碳监测。所有控制器加标签且儿童够不到；控制面板须可锁、防拆。[T3][T4]

Plumbing points给排水要点

Hot water: temperature controlled water at all fixtures accessible to children, at a maximum of 49 degrees C or 120 degrees F, with mixing valves and high temperature limit controls; high temperature water goes to the kitchen, dishwasher, laundry and janitor’s sinks. Provide a dedicated water meter for the child care facility, a domestic hot water recirculation line, floor drains with trap primers in washrooms, kitchen, laundry, janitor and service rooms, hose bibs on each side of the building exterior, in the outdoor play area and in the garbage and recycling area (frost-free, with vacuum breaker, vandal-resistant), and sediment traps on all area drains and all art sinks.热水：儿童可及洁具的水温受控，最高 49 °C（120 °F），配混水阀与高温限位；高温水供厨房、洗碗机、洗衣与清洁间水槽。为托儿设施设专用水表与生活热水循环管；洗手间、厨房、洗衣房、清洁间与服务间地漏配存水弯补水器；建筑外墙每侧、室外游乐区与垃圾回收区设水龙头（防冻、带真空破坏器、防 vandalism）；所有区域排水口与美术水槽配沉淀隔。[S7]

Filtration and fixture flow rates (Appendix B)过滤与洁具流量（附录 B）

MERV of at least 11 for equipment that requires filtration material; where applicable, GeoPleat or Mini-Pleat filter with MERV 13 must be used. Targeted fixture flush/flow rates are in Table B-1 — the full table is on Page 4.需过滤材料的设备至少 MERV 11；适用处必须用 MERV 13 的 GeoPleat 或 Mini-Pleat。洁具冲水／流量目标值在表 B-1——全表见页 4。[T1] Go to Page 4 · Technical Standards →去看页 4 · 技术标准速查 →

Electrical: power, lighting, phone and data电气：电力、照明、电话与数据

Power电力

All outlets to be childproof with shatterproof faceplates. Provide dedicated circuit T-slot (15/20A) GFCI receptacles in the Kitchen and adequate numbers of GFCI outlets in the Outdoor Play Areas; dedicated circuits for fridges, washer and dryer, freezer, photocopier, and security card, DDC and access equipment. Where the building has an emergency power generator, the emergency lighting system including exit lights shall be powered by separate emergency battery packs installed in the child care facility. Provide a separate hydro meter for the child care in a shared facility.所有插座儿童安全型、防碎面板。厨房设专用回路 T 型（15/20A）GFCI 插座，室外游乐区设足够数量的 GFCI 插座；冰箱、洗衣干衣机、冷冻柜、复印机与安防卡、DDC、门禁设备各设专用回路。建筑有应急发电机时，应急照明（含出口灯）须由装在托儿设施内的独立应急电池组供电。共享设施中托儿部分设独立电表。

Lighting levels照度

All lighting must be dimmable. LED lighting is preferred, temperature between 2700 K and 3500 K where appropriate. Provide one fixture wall sconce in all gross motor/nap rooms and quiet rooms, to serve as a night light. Provide CCFL Guideline Lighting Levels as a minimum (review Infant Program lighting levels with CCFL):所有照明须可调光。LED 为佳，色温在适当场合取 2700 K 到 3500 K。所有大运动／午睡房与安静室设 1 盏壁灯作夜灯。至少提供 CCFL 指引照度（婴儿项目照度与 CCFL 复核）：

Work surfaces get the higher level; play rooms the lower.工作面用高 1 档；游乐房用低 1 档。[C43]

Lighting controls照明控制

Lighting systems must be operated through Direct Digital Controls (DDC), monitored by the City’s DDC network (Appendix C). Arrange switching so fixtures in activity rooms can be controlled in groups at varying levels; wall sconces on dimmers in the gross motor/nap room and quiet room; occupancy sensors in rooms with infrequent use; photo sensors and an over-ride switch for outdoor lighting, connected to the DDC system.照明系统须通过 DDC 运行、由市府 DDC 网络监测（附录 C）。活动室灯具分组开关以调不同亮度；大运动／午睡房与安静室的壁灯接调光器；低频使用房间装人体感应；室外照明装光感与手动越控开关并接入 DDC。

Telephone and data电话与数据

Telephone: a minimum of one jack in the kitchen, parent room, staff break room and administration office, and two jacks in the activity room; a telephone and enterphone connection at the reception, activity room and covered outdoor play area; all Tel/Data cabling Cat6 with RJ45 jacks. Data outlets have per-room minimums (diagram below), with space allowed for a City fibre network connection, and ceiling outlets for Wi-Fi covering all public and staff use areas.电话：厨房、家长室、员工休息室与行政办公室至少各 1 个插座，活动室至少 2 个；接待处、活动室与有盖室外游乐区设电话与对讲连接；所有电话／数据线缆 Cat6 配 RJ45。数据口有每间房最低数（见下图），并预留市政光纤接入空间；天花设 Wi-Fi 口覆盖所有公共与员工区域。[C44][C45]

Fire alarm, security, electrical room消防报警、安防与电气间

Fire alarm: ensure a non-proprietary alarm system is installed; any pull stations located at child height require a cover; add 2 lines to the main fire alarm panel. After-hours security: provide an intruder alarm system. The electrical room needs adequate wall space for cable service, telephone termination, security, network switches, City fibre termination, VOIP switch and cabling panels, plus a separate communications conduit (minimum 2 in.) to the outside, and a minimum of two separate dedicated communications circuits. The typical wall:消防报警：须装非专有系统；位于儿童高度的手动报警按钮须加保护盖；主消防报警主机加 2 条线路。非营业时段安防：设入侵报警系统。电气间须有足够墙面放有线服务、电话端接、安防、网络交换机、市政光纤端接、VOIP 交换机与配线架，外加 1 条独立通信导管（最小 2 in）通室外，以及至少 2 条独立专用通信回路。典型墙面：[C46]

Reserve the whole wall — the services list is long.整面墙留出来——要装的系统很长 1 串。

Blinds, signage, elevator, seismic, garbage room窗帘、标识、电梯、抗震与垃圾房

Window blinds: commercial grade, chain operated roller style preferred, on all exterior windows and in nap rooms, quiet rooms and parent rooms; all cords or chains to terminate 5 feet above the floor, or have a hook tie-off at that height. Signage: an illuminated exterior sign with the facility name and address, visible from the street, plus wayfinding at entries to each Group in shared facilities. Elevators serving child care facilities with rooftop play areas must accommodate freight for maintaining the play areas — a minimum capacity of 4,000 pounds is recommended; a dedicated elevator’s controllers must be non-proprietary. Seismic: all furnishings greater than 4 ft. high should be secured to prevent tipping. The garbage and recycling room is provided in addition to child care space — see the Appendices B–L overview and Page 4 for its container sizing.窗帘：商业级、首选链式卷帘，装所有外窗及午睡房、安静室、家长室；所有绳或链下端终止于距地 5 英尺处，或在该高度设挂钩系留。标识：带设施名称与地址的发光室外招牌、从街道可见；共享设施中每组入口设导向标识。服务带屋顶游乐区的托儿电梯须能运送游乐区维护货物——建议最小载重 4,000 磅；专用电梯的控制器须非专有。抗震：所有高于 4 ft 的家具应固定防倾倒。垃圾回收房在托儿空间之外另行提供——其容器 sizing 见附录 B–L 总览与页 4。[C47][C48]

Named models, monitoring panels and flow-rate tables for these systems are on 这些系统的点名型号、监控主机与流量表在Page 4 · Technical Standards页 4 · 技术标准速查.。

Guess first, then check先猜再看

Guess first: what lighting level is the minimum in children’s activity rooms?先猜：儿童活动室的最低照度是多少？

Answer: 40 ft. candles (420 lux) in children’s activity rooms; 50 ft. candles (540 lux) in the kitchen, offices and washrooms.答案：活动室 40 ft. candles（420 lux）；厨房、办公室与洗手间 50 ft. candles（540 lux）。[C43]

Guess first: what is the high flush volume of the specified dual-flush toilets?先猜：指定双冲马桶的高档冲水量是多少？

Answer: Table B-1 targets: dual-flush toilets High = 6.0 LPF, Low = 3.4 to 4.1 LPF; 9.3 LPM is the top of the shower range.答案：表 B-1 目标：双冲马桶高档 6.0 LPF、低档 3.4–4.1 LPF；9.3 是淋浴流量的上限（LPM）。[T2]

Guess first: which battery type do the specified exit signs use?先猜：指定出口标志用什么电池？

Answer: Exit signs use LED light sources with NiCad emergency batteries, in the “Running Man” style.答案：出口标志用 LED 光源＋NiCad 应急电池，「Running Man」式样。[T6]

Can you answer these?你答得上来吗

Q: How many data outlets, at minimum, in each activity room?问：每个活动室最少要几个数据口？

3 outlets in each activity room (and 3 in each office, 1 for DDC controls, 1 in the parent room, 2 for the staff room).每个活动室 3 个（办公室也是 3 个、DDC 控制 1 个、家长室 1 个、员工室 2 个）。[C45]

Q: For an elevator serving a child care facility with a rooftop play area, what minimum capacity is recommended?问：服务带屋顶游乐区托儿设施的电梯，建议最小载重是多少？

A minimum capacity of 4,000 pounds is recommended, so the elevator can accommodate freight for maintaining the rooftop play areas.建议最小载重 4,000 磅，以便运送屋顶游乐区的维护货物。[C47]

Q: In which rooms must permanent CO₂ and CO monitoring be installed, at minimum?问：永久 CO₂／CO 监测至少要装在哪些房间？

Install permanent, hard-wired carbon dioxide and monoxide monitoring systems, in at minimum the activity rooms and the gross motor/nap rooms.须在至少活动室与大运动／午睡房装永久硬接线的 CO₂ 与 CO 监测系统。[T3]

Q: What lighting control is called for where there is natural light?问：有自然光的地方要求什么照明控制？

Appendix D calls for daylight harvesting in areas with natural light, with LED and linear fluorescent preferred indoors.附录 D 要求有自然光处做 daylight harvesting；室内优先 LED 与线性荧光。[T5]

Threshold-triggered areas门槛触发的区域

Garbage/recycling and service rooms垃圾回收与设备间

From net to gross从净面积到总面积

To determine the gross floor area and account for walls, circulation, stairways, elevators and service rooms, add in the range of 20% to 30% to the combined net indoor area inclusive of shared and other areas. The gross floor area will also depend on efficiencies and construction. New facilities built as City capital projects or developer amenity contributions must include the minimum net activity, support and outdoor areas noted for each program type.为得出总建筑面积并计入墙体、交通、楼梯、电梯与设备间，在合并净室内面积（含共享与其他区）上加 20% 到 30%；总面积还取决于效率与构造。市资本项目或开发商配套贡献新建的设施，必须包含各项目类型所列的最小净活动、支持与室外面积。[S3]

Appendix A · Space Summary Tables — Part 2: Reading the Program Tables (pp. 50–56)附录 A · 面积测算（后半 · 分表 pp.50–56）

How each program table is built — activity items, nap rooms, support items, then NET INDOOR AREA; a matching outdoor table; and the footnotes that decide what is not counted. Every type’s items are expanded on Page 3; this page teaches the reading method and the traps.每个项目表怎么构成——活动分项、午睡房、支持分项，然后是净室内面积；再配 1 张室外表；以及决定「什么不算」的脚注。每种类型的分项在页 3 展开；本页讲读表方法与陷阱。

The build-up, using the Infant table (A-2)构成方法：以婴儿班表 A-2 为例

Each per-program table adds up the same way. For Infant (birth to 18 months, 12 children): activity items Open Play Area 161 + Climbing, crawling, interactive 215 + Quiet area 101 = 477; Nap Rooms 280 (2 required at 13 sq. m. each) bring the activity total to 757; support items (Kitchen 100, Children’s Washroom & Diapering Area 80, General Storage 86, Nap Room Storage 50, Cubby Area 130, Parent Sign-in 22, Staff Comms 32, Staff Office 100) total 600; NET INDOOR AREA 1,357 ft² (126.1 sq. m.). The outdoor table (A-3) mirrors it: Covered 323 + Open 646 = Total Outdoor Activity Areas 969 (90.0 sq. m.); Outdoor Storage 86; NET OUTDOOR AREA 1,055.每张分表的加法都一样。以婴儿班（出生到 18 个月，12 人）为例：活动分项开放游玩 161＋攀爬爬行互动 215＋安静区 101＝477；午睡房 280（须 2 间、每间 13 m²）使活动区合计 757；支持分项（厨房 100、儿童洗手间与换尿布区 80、通用储藏 86、午睡房储藏 50、储物柜区 130、家长签到 22、员工沟通台 32、员工办公室 100）合计 600；净室内面积 1,357 ft²（126.1 m²）。室外表 A-3 同理：有盖 323＋露天 646＝室外活动区合计 969（90.0 m²）；室外储藏 86；净室外 1,055。[R7][A2]

The per-child yardstick inside the tables表内的每孩标尺

The Main Activity Area line is based on a min. of 40 ft² or 3.7 sq. m. per child — the same 40 ft² per child that Appendix K states for the activity room, excluding circulation and built-in millwork.主活动区 1 行按每孩最低 40 ft²（3.7 m²）计算——与附录 K 对活动室的说法一致，且不含流线与内置木作。[S2]

What the tables exclude这些表不含什么

Per the table footnotes, the net indoor areas exclude the gross-up factor, and exclude the shared items of Table A-1 — entry, stroller storage, laundry, janitor, accessible washroom and staff room. Add the shared set once per facility (Appendix A Part 1), then gross up 20% to 30%.按附表脚注，净室内面积不含放大系数，也不含 Table A-1 的共享项——入口、婴儿车存放、洗衣、清洁、无障碍洗手间与员工房。做法：共享集全设施加 1 次（附录 A 前半），再放大 20% 到 30%。[A1][S3]

Appendix B · Building Equipment, Monitoring and Integration附录 B · 建筑设备、监控与集成

The City’s equipment and integration requirements, including filtration and the targeted fixture flow rates of Table B-1. Key item: MERV of at least 11; where applicable, GeoPleat or Mini-Pleat filter with MERV 13 must be used.市府的设备与集成要求，含过滤与表 B-1 的洁具流量目标。关键 1 条：MERV 至少 11；适用处必须用 MERV 13 的 GeoPleat 或 Mini-Pleat。[T1]

Appendix C · Direct Digital Control (DDC) and Energy Monitoring附录 C · 直接数字控制 DDC 与能耗监测

DDC and energy monitoring guidelines for City-owned spaces in non-City-managed new construction. Appendix D · General Lighting Guidelines附录 D · 通用照明指引

Material and design requirements for lighting in City buildings. Key item: the “Running Man” style EXIT sign conforming to CAN/ULC-S572, LED source, NiCad emergency battery.市属建筑照明的材料与设计要求。关键 1 条：「Running Man」式出口标志，符合 CAN/ULC-S572，LED 光源、NiCad 应急电池。[T6]

Appendix E · Entrance Intercom/Video Systems Specifications附录 E · 入口对讲／视频系统规格

Specifications for entry intercom and video systems in City buildings. Key item: acceptable part numbers are Viking K-1200 or K-1200EWP, no exceptions allowed.市属建筑入口对讲与视频系统规格。关键 1 条：可接受型号只有 Viking K-1200 或 K-1200EWP，不许例外。[T7]

Appendix F · Security, Fire Alarm Systems Specifications附录 F · 安防与消防报警系统规格

Security alarm, fire alarm monitoring, access and video specifications. Key item: the fire alarm monitoring system panel must be a DSC 4116 ULC Fire Kit, no substitutions.安防报警、消防报警监控、门禁与视频规格。关键 1 条：消防监控主机须为 DSC 4116 ULC Fire Kit，不得替换。[T8]

Appendix G · Garbage Container Specifications附录 G · 垃圾桶规格

Appendix H · Rooftop Playground Design Guidelines附录 H · 屋顶游乐场设计指引

Irrigation requirements for rooftop and grade-related projects. Key item: controller to be Toro Sentinel Satellite SSAK-12XXX-6-N-S, with irrigation shop drawings provided to the City for review.屋顶与地面相关项目的灌溉要求。关键 1 条：控制器为 Toro Sentinel Satellite SSAK-12XXX-6-N-S，灌溉施工图须送市府审查。[T12]

Guess first: how many appendices does this overview cover, from B to L?先猜：本总览覆盖的附录从 B 到 L，共有几个？

Answer: eleven appendices, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K and L (Appendix A is the space summary, Parts 1–2).答案：11 个——B、C、D、E、F、G、H、I、J、K、L（附录 A 是空间汇总，见附录 A 前半、后半）。

Guess first: at most how high may the entry intercom be mounted, flush at the door?先猜：入口对讲门机齐平安装，最高可装多高？

Answer: the entry intercom is mounted flush at a maximum height of 44 in.; 72 in. is the fire alarm panel limit.答案：入口对讲齐平安装高度不超过 44 in；72 in 是消防主机的上限。[T7]

Guess first: how big is the termination space for the alarm/security panel?先猜：报警／安防主机的端接空间有多大？

Answer: the alarm security panel termination point is 24 in. × 30 in.; 24 in. × 24 in. is the fire alarm panel's own termination space.答案：报警安防主机端接点 24 in × 30 in；24 in × 24 in 是消防主机自身的端接空间。[T8]

Can you answer these?你答得上来吗

Q: Which two contractors may do the City’s DDC work?问：市府 DDC 工程可由哪 2 家承包商做？

One of the City’s two prequalified Supply and Installation Contractors for DDC Systems must be used — currently either ESC Automation or Control Solutions (Appendix C).必须用市府 2 家预审 DDC 供应与安装承包商之 1——现为 ESC Automation 或 Control Solutions（附录 C）。[T4]

Q: Which controller does Appendix I specify for irrigation?问：附录 I 指定的灌溉控制器是哪款？

Controller to be Toro Sentinel Satellite SSAK-12XXX-6-N-S (the XXX is a placeholder for wall mounted vs. pedestal); shop drawings go to the City for review.控制器为 Toro Sentinel Satellite SSAK-12XXX-6-N-S（XXX 是壁挂／基座的占位符）；施工图送市府审查。[T12]

Q: Which access-control readers does Appendix F specify?问：附录 F 指定的门禁读卡器是哪种？

Appendix F specifies HID proximity card readers, with a Honeywell Webs-AX system.附录 F 指定 HID 感应读卡器，系统为 Honeywell Webs-AX。[T9]

Q: Which plant does Table J-1 list as poisonous in all parts?问：表 J-1 里哪种植物全株有毒？

Table J-1 lists Monkshood/Wolfbane (Aconitum spp.), all parts poisonous; Vine Maple appears in the suitable-trees table instead.表 J-1 里 Monkshood/Wolfbane（Aconitum spp.）全株有毒；Vine Maple 是适种树木表里的。[T13]
